article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [News Weekly] The CCP uses mosquitoes to vaccinate bats; scholars warn it could be used to spread viruses | Plague | Unrestricted Warfare | CCP Virus Origin | New Tang Dynasty Television
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-15, NTDTV reports that Chinese virologists at the Wuhan Institute of Virology have developed mosquitoes carrying vaccines to immunize bats against rabies and Nipah virus. Experimental results indicate that bats exposed to vaccine-bearing mosquitoes mount strong immune responses to rabies and Nipah virus antigens. The Wuhan institute allegedly deployed these mosquitoes to induce immunity in bat populations. Analysts warn the dual-use nature of this approach could enable the global dissemination of lethal pathogens, by turning mosquitoes into vectors that deliver modified viruses to wild bats and potentially generate unpredictable, high-consequence viruses. The piece frames this as a potential tool for epidemic or bio-warfare scenarios. Quotes from commentator Tang Jingyuan and other figures describe the technology as turning bats into natural drones and suggest it could be hard to trace. The report also cites political commentary linking the Wuhan lab to pandemic origins.

article.articleHeadline: मच्छरों से बनेगी वैक्सीन! निपाह-रेबीज़ वायरस फैला रहे चमगादड़ों का होगा इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A vaccine will be made from mosquitoes! Bats spreading Nipah and Rabies viruses will be treated.
article.articleSummary: Scientists are developing a vaccine produced via mosquitoes to immunize bats against Nipah and Rabies. The approach uses mosquitoes carrying vaccine-like elements in their saliva, which can reach bats when they bite or are ingested. In laboratory studies with mice and bats, this delivery method elicited antibodies against Nipah and Rabies, indicating potential protective immunity. The aim is to reduce bat-to-human spillover of infections by vaccinating wildlife through their insect vectors. If proven safe and effective, this strategy could offer a novel way to curb animal-to-human transmission. Current results are preliminary and limited to controlled lab settings, requiring further safety and efficacy testing before any field use.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊から作られるワクチン！ニパーとラビーズウイルスを広めるコウモリが治療される
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスとラビーズは重要な人獣共通感染症だが、本記事は研究段階の実験的ワクチン開発についての報道であり、現在のアウトブレイク状況や実際の患者・死亡の報告は含まれていない。引き続き感染動向の情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はニパーウイルスとラビーズウイルスという高リスク病原体の予防戦略に関するものだが、現在のアウトブレイク情報や患者発生の報告は含まれていない。実験段階の開発進捗に関する報道であるため、シグナルピックアップに至らず。ただしニパーウイルスは高い致死率と国際的関心を持つため、この地域での感染状況に関する続報を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ucayali: eliminan más de 130 toneladas de potenciales criaderos del zancudo que transmite el dengue en la región
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ucayali: More than 130 tons of potential breeding sites for the dengue-transmitting mosquito eliminated in the region
article.articleSummary: 133.7 tons of potential dengue breeding sites eliminated in the Ucayali region, Peru, this year under the Ministry of Health’s Dengue Prevention and Control Plan 2026, across eight districts: Raimondi (224.1), Calleria (33.5), Manantay (21.4), Monte Alegre (23.4), Yarinacocha (21.2), Campo Verde (2.7), Padre Abad (6.9), and Alexander Von Humbolt (0.6) tons. Campaigns targeted containers that collect rainwater—coconut shells, bottles, tires, old pots, toys, and other discarded receptacles. Health networks Aguaytía-San Alejandro, Atalaya, Coronel Portillo, and Federico Basadre trained residents to identify and eliminate breeding sites, including washing, scrubbing, and covering water containers. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, presents with high fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, retro-orbital pain, and skin rashes; alarm signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, drowsiness, irritability, and weakness. Seek care promptly and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ウカヤリ州：デング熱を媒介する蚊の130トン以上の潜在的な繁殖地を地域で撲滅
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防・制御活動に関する報道であり、異常な感染症イベントの報告ではなく、既知のリスク対策の実施状況を報じたもの。シグナル基準の該当が少ないため、経過観察に分類。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、ペルー保健省による定期的なデング熱予防・制御計画の実施状況を報じたもの。ウカヤリ州ではデング熱の流行リスクが継続的に存在し、当局が蚊の繁殖地排除活動を展開している状況を示す。IHR基準は該当せず、WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行感受性が認められるが、政府レベルでの対応状況を示す予防的ニュースであるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Meningkat di Padang, Puskesmas Dadok Catat 24 Orang Terinfeksi pada 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rising in Padang, Dadok Community Health Center records 24 people infected in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in Padang, Indonesia, with Puskesmas Dadok reporting 24 suspected infections from January through mid-March 2026 in its catchment area, including Kelurahan Andalas, Dadok Tunggul Hitam, and Parak Kerakah. January 12, February 6, and March 6 cases were recorded in 2026; laboratory confirmation has not yet been conducted for all suspects, though patients exhibit classic measles symptoms such as a spotty rash on the body, and their conditions have improved. Puskesmas Dadok is conducting field inspections, providing public education, and instructing families to isolate affected individuals to prevent intra-household spread. In 2025, Dadok recorded 150 measles cases. Parak Kerakah Health Center also reported six measles infections in 2026 (January: 2; February: 4; March: 0). Authorities continue surveillance and community outreach to curb transmission. No deaths reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: パダン市のはしか患者が増加、ダドク保健センターが2026年に24人の感染を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パダン市でのはしか患者増加（24例）が報告されているが、情報の一部が不完全であり、国際的拡大や深刻な影響の可能性を判定するために追加情報が必要である。
triage.notes: パダン市では2025年に150例のはしか患者が記録されており、2026年上半期にも複数の地区で患者が報告されている。検査確認が未実施の患者が存在するため、確定例数が不明確である。死亡例は報告されていないが、重症度に関する情報が限定的である。地域的な流行傾向の監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: आता डास देणार लस! वटवाघळांपासून होणारा निपाह आणि रेबिजचा धोका टळणार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now mosquitoes will give vaccines! The Nipah and rabies threats from bats will be eliminated.
article.articleSummary: Beijing-based scientists are pursuing an unconventional strategy to curb Nipah and rabies spillovers from bats by using mosquitoes as vaccine carriers. In the approach, Aedes aegypti mosquitoes are fed blood containing Nipah or rabies vaccines so the vaccine disseminates to their salivary glands. When these vaccinated mosquitoes bite bats, antibodies against Nipah and rabies were detected in laboratory tests, and subsequent experiments in mice and bats showed anti-viral antibodies. If scalable, this could prevent bat-to-human transmission, reducing future outbreaks. However, experts warn that controlling which individuals are bitten by mosquitoes is highly challenging, and it remains unclear whether transmission would be truly halted. Alternative methods, such as drinking stations where vaccinated solutions are placed for water-consuming bats, are being explored. The work is in early stages and laboratory-based.

triage.headline_ja: 今、蚊がワクチンを与える！コウモリからのニパーとラビーの脅威が排除される
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスとラビーズウイルスの人獣共通感染症リスクは認識されるが、本記事は実験段階の予防的研究報告であり、現在の流行や発生事例を伝えるものではない。情報収集価値はあるが、緊急対応対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Virulence and resistance adaptation of Streptococcus agalactiae Ib/ST261 infecting bullfrogs in Hainan, China between 2019 and 2023 - Brazilian Journal of Microbiology
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype Ib/ST261 has emerged as the dominant bullfrog pathogen causing high mortality in Hainan, China, from 2019–2023. Virulence gene profile remains stable across 2019 and 2023 isolates: pavA + sip + iagA + cfb + hylB + bibA + cspA + fbsA. Resistance-associated mutations persist: gyrA (S81L), parC (D83Y), pbp1A (Y305F, A604T, N639S), pbp2B (V79A, S247F, S313P, N412D, T656I). Despite consistently high phenotypic resistance to tetracycline (97%), chloramphenicol (92%), cotrimoxazole (92%), sulfamethoxazole (90%), and penicillin (90%), acquired resistance genes tetM, aacC2, sul1, sul2 were largely lost. Environmental stress from 2019 to 2023 coincided with pronounced AMR shifts: imipenem resistance up fourfold; spectinomycin, streptomycin, and amikacin resistance increased 34-, 46-, and 49.7-fold, respectively. Biofilm formation remains weak, underscoring persistent virulence and multidrug resistance that challenge treatment of bullfrog bacteremia in aquaculture.

triage.triage_reason: 水産養殖における動物病原体の多剤耐性化と耐性遺伝子の動向は公衆衛生上の潜在的関心を持つが、人間への直接的な感染リスクについての明記がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは水産養殖（ウシガエル）における動物病原体に関する研究論文である。Streptococcus agalactiae Ib/ST261は人間にも感染可能な病原体であるが、記事は動物単体の感染に焦点を当てており、人獣共通感染症への拡大リスクについての言及がない。2019-2023年の長期観察期間における多剤耐性化（imipenem耐性が4倍、amikacin耐性が49.7倍に増加）は公衆衛生上の懸念事項であるが、人間への実際の影響については記載されていない。継続的なシグナルとなる可能性を備えているため、関連情報の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Live: राज्यसभा चुनाव से पहले JDU की खास मीटिंग, दानापुर में चेचक का कहर, 50 बीमार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Live: JDU's special meeting ahead of the Rajya Sabha elections, smallpox outbreak in Danapur, 50 ill.
article.articleSummary: Smallpox outbreak reported in Gopalpur village, Danapur subdivision, Bihar. As of 15 March 2026, more than 50 people have contracted smallpox, prompting public health concern. A physician at a nearby referral hospital reports about 35 individuals have shown symptoms; new cases continue to appear. Affected patients are being treated, with medicines and vitamins supplied by the hospital. Authorities warn that smallpox is highly contagious and urge residents to avoid close contact. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, implying diagnoses are based on clinical signs. The outbreak in Danapur, Bihar, requires urgent public health response for containment and patient care in the affected community.

triage.triage_reason: 天然痘（根絶宣言済み疾患）のインド・ビハール州での発生報告。50人以上の患者と持続的な新規発症報告があり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。緊急のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 天然痘は1980年にWHOが根絶宣言した疾患であり、本報告は極めて異常。ただし記事がヒンディー語のニュースサイトで、政治ニュース（ラージヤ・サバー選挙）と混在しており、情報の確実性確認が必要。実験室確認の記載がなく臨床診断のみとされているため、検査による確定診断の早急な実施が重要。WHO及び関連国際機関への即時通知が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Orang Tua Diimbau Tunda Mudik Bila Anak Tunjukkan Gejala Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parents Urged to Postpone Homecoming If Their Child Shows Measles Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Measles activity in Indonesia shows a national downturn in suspected cases (10,826) and confirmed cases (8,716) through week 9 of 2026, after a January uptick, with 45 outbreaks (KLB) in 29 districts/cities across 11 provinces. Lab confirmation occurs in 11 provinces; NTB (Bima Regency and Bima City) remains high with 544 suspected and 476 confirmed cases. Despite the decline, officials urge parents to monitor children during Lebaran travel and delay trips if fever, rash, cough, runny nose, or red eyes appear, given measles’ high contagion (12–18 others). PHBS measures include masks for respiratory symptoms and in crowded places, plus handwashing. ORI MR immunization underway in 22 districts/cities; two districts not yet started after KLB. CuC MR immunization is highest in Jakarta Barat 56.4%, Jakarta Pusat 80.4%, Depok 17.3%, Tangerang Selatan 8.4%, Palu 5.6%. Immunization services at Puskesmas/Posyandu and Mudik points; parents should verify MR vaccination at 9 and 18 months.

triage.headline_ja: 親に対して、子どもが麻疹の症状を示した場合は帰郷を延期するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹の複数地域での同時多発（11州29地区で45件のアウトブレイク）、高い確定患者数（8,716例）、ヒト-ヒト感染性が高い（12-18人に伝播）ため、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）およびWPRO基準（異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当し、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 2026年第9週時点でインドネシア全国で疑い患者10,826例、確定患者8,716例、45件のアウトブレイク。特にNTB州のビマ郡・ビマ市が高リスク（476確定例）。レバラン帰郷時期の旅行に伴う感染拡大リスク、MRワクチン接種率の地域格差（バリエーション大：5.6%-80.4%）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about 'banh mi' food poisoning in Vietnam, and how to eat it safely
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces suspected mass banh mi-related food poisoning in Ho Chi Minh City in early March, with about 130 people hospitalised in Hanh Thong and Vung Tau Wards as southern Vietnam enters the hot season. While banh mi itself is rarely the direct cause, issues center on pâté, cold cuts, and Vietnamese mayo, especially large, unrefrigerated pâté blocks (0.5–1 kg) from stalls. Common pathogens include Salmonella and E. coli; symptoms include diarrhea, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, potentially dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; severe cases can progress to systemic infection or sepsis. Incubation for Salmonella roughly 0.5–72 hours. Contamination can occur via unclean handling, utensils, or unsanitary markets, and heat accelerates spoilage. Health authorities in Ho Chi Minh City are increasing inspections; advice remains to ensure thorough cooking and avoid raw/undercooked dishes during hot weather.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのバインミー食中毒について知っておくべきこと、および安全な食べ方
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で約130人の食中毒集団発生（腸チフス、パラチフス、大腸菌）が報告され、IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、WPROスクリーニングでは重症度（入院事例多数）と流行しやすさ（食品媒介感染、多くの人が曝露）の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 約130人の入院患者が報告される集団食中毒事例。腸チフス、パラチフス、大腸菌が関連する食品媒介感染。ホーチミン市の保健当局が検査強化中。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクについては記事内に明記されていないため「不明」と評価。南ベトナムの高温シーズン到来に伴う衛生管理の課題が背景にあるとみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Leproso | Columna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leper | Column.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) is depicted through Juan Campos’s life from Málaga, diagnosed in 1962 and interned at Trillo leprosery in Guadalajara, facing extreme stigma and family rejection. By 1968 he could return as antibiotics reduced contagion; in 1981 a three-drug multidrug therapy cured the disease, with WHO providing free MDT since then. Campos’s later health deteriorated, culminating in suicide at 60 in 1993. Lola Campos has published Nuestro Dios privado, drawing on Fontilles in Alicante—the last European leprosy sanatorium and a global reference center—to recount patient testimonies and the quiet, enduring mistreatment of individuals with leprosy in Spain. Spain reports 10–15 new cases per year, while leprosy remains ongoing globally, especially in India.

triage.headline_ja: レプラス | コラム
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は歴史的事例と患者証言に基づくコラム記事であり、新規発生事象ではない。スペインの年間新規症例数は10～15例と限定的で、公衆衛生上の危機的状況は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は1962年に診断されたスペイン人患者の歴史的な個人経歴およびハンセン病患者の社会的スティグマに関する文学的コラム。現在の流行状況や異常な疾病増加を示すシグナルではなく、歴史的な医学・社会的論評である。スペインの年間症例数は安定して低水準。

article.articleHeadline: Melawan DBD dengan Kampanye United Against Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting Dengue Fever with the United Against Dengue Campaign.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a serious threat in Indonesia. The United Against Dengue (UAD): Joint Initiative to Fight Dengue campaign was launched in Jakarta by Takeda Innovative Medicines, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), and the Indonesian Red Cross (PMI). Indonesia is the first country to activate the national partnership, following a regional UAD launch in June 2025. The campaign aims to strengthen prevention, preparedness and community-based interventions through multi-sector collaboration, evidence-based strategies and innovations to reduce transmission and disease severity. Takeda's Andreas Gutknecht emphasized the goal of zero dengue deaths by 2030; IFRC's Kathryn Clarkson highlighted building community resilience; PMI’s Fachmi Idris connected the effort to national dengue-control strategies. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; WHO reported 14.6 million cases and 12,000 deaths worldwide in 2024. In 2024, Indonesia’s BPJS Kesehatan recorded 1,055,255 dengue hospitalizations, with nearly Rp 3 trillion in economic burden.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と戦う「United Against Dengue」キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は地域的に重大な問題であり、インドネシアでの大規模な症例報告と経済的負担が確認されるが、新規の急性感染拡大やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、公衆衛生キャンペーンの進展報告であるため、現時点では情報収集継続が適切。
triage.notes: 2024年のインドネシアでの報告数は105万5,255例の入院患者で、経済的負担は約3兆ルピア。本記事はキャンペーン発足の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクを示す証拠ではない。しかし、デング熱の持続的な脅威とWHO報告による2024年の世界的な1,460万例・12,000死亡は重大な公衆衛生関心事であり、WPRO地域における継続的な疫学監視の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada KLB Campak saat Mudik Lebaran, Lindungi Buah Hati dengan Imunisasi di RS Awal Bros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be alert to a measles outbreak during Eid al-Fitr homecoming; protect your child with immunization at Awal Bros Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of March 15, 2026, measles outbreaks in Indonesia include a measles emergency declared in Riau province. Indonesia ranks second globally in measles outbreak cases, with 72 child deaths from measles-related complications reported. Measles is highly contagious via airborne transmission, and Eid al-Fitr/mudik gatherings pose high risk, especially for children under five not fully vaccinated, immunocompromised individuals, and pregnant women. Early symptoms resemble flu: high fever, cough, runny nose, and conjunctivitis, followed by rash. RS Awal Bros urges parents to seek medical care promptly if a child develops high fever with a rash, to enable early diagnosis and management; severe cases may include breathing difficulties, ear pain, diarrhea, or dehydration. Preventive measures include MR/MMR vaccination: first dose at 9 months, boosters at 18 months and 5–7 years; maintain hand hygiene, masks, and good nutrition. The hospital network offers vaccination services and pediatric consultations ahead of the homecoming period.

triage.headline_ja: レバラン帰省時の麻疹流行に警戒、アワルブロス病院での予防接種で子どもを保護
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの麻疹・インフルエンザ同時流行。麻疹は世界第2位の流行規模（72人の小児死亡報告）、高い伝播性、レバラン帰省による国内広がりリスクが高く、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、異常性）に該当。
triage.notes: リアウ州での麻疹緊急事態宣言が発出されている。レバラン帰省（mudik）という大規模人口移動が予定されており、麻疹の域内拡大リスクが高い。5歳以下の未接種児、免疫低下者、妊婦が特に脆弱。空気感染による高い伝播性。インドネシア全体での死亡者72人は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Man Arrested For Injecting Woman With His Own HIV Positive Blood
article.articleSummary: An HIV-positive man was arrested in Telangana's Medchal-Malkajgiri district for allegedly injecting his own HIV-positive blood into a 24-year-old woman after her family called off the marriage. The incident occurred in Ghatkesar town when the man forced a syringe of his blood into the woman. The accused is a close relative; his HIV status was confirmed six months earlier in a lab in Uppal when the father had him tested after the marriage was called off. The woman was taken to a private hospital in Uppal and later shifted to Gandhi Hospital for treatment. The police arrested him on Saturday and he was remanded to 14 days judicial custody; the investigation is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 男性がHIV陽性血液を女性に注射して逮捕 テランガナ州
triage.triage_reason: 意図的なHIV感染行為という異常かつ予想外の犯罪行為であり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・公衆衛生への潜在的影響）に該当。社会的関心も高く、医療・法執行関連の即時対応が必要なシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症イベントというより刑事犯罪（意図的な感染行為）の側面が強いが、公衆衛生および感染症管理の観点から即時対応が必要。被害者の治療・心理サポート、感染拡大の疫学的追跡、および類似事案の予防啓発が重要。警察・医療機関・保健当局の連携体制の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu can already get inside human cells. So why hasn't it sparked a pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5N1 has ripped through poultry farms, killing tens of millions of chickens and turkeys, and recently spilled into dairy cattle, while human cases remain very rare as of March 2026. Although avian flu can enter human cells, a multi-layer cellular defense blocks sustained spread. A DNA-sensing STING pathway triggers NF-κB–driven antiviral responses; GADD34, a key gene activated by STING, helps limit replication. In experiments with lab mice and human lung cells, removing STING or GADD34 leads to higher viral levels and more severe disease, underscoring STING as an important barrier. The avian M1 matrix protein, by suppressing STING signaling, appears to be chosen in many human pandemic strains—over 95% carry this mutation. This points to multiple checkpoints beyond receptor binding that the virus must clear to spill over, with potential therapeutic targeting of STING-M1 interactions. Research reported from Zhejiang University, China, and published in Science.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザは既にヒト細胞に侵入できる。では、なぜパンデミックを引き起こさないのか？
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の人への感染メカニズムに関する基礎研究報告であり、現時点での人間への実際の脅威は限定的。ただし、今後の病原体進化や公衆衛生的関心が高い領域のため、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は科学的メカニズム研究（STING経路、M1蛋白質の役割）に焦点を当てた基礎研究の報告。2026年3月時点で人間への感染は依然として稀であり、パンデミック発生の危機的段階にはない。ただし、H5N1は家禽および乳牛での流行が継続中であり、スピルオーバーリスクは存在。PNAS掲載で科学的信頼性は高い。引き続き同領域の感染者報告および遺伝的変化を監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ada 200 Kasus Campak di Balikpapan, Mayoritas Penderita Tak Divaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are 200 measles cases in Balikpapan, with the majority of patients unvaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Balikpapan City, Indonesia records more than 200 suspected measles cases across the city, with the majority of patients unvaccinated or incompletely immunized. As of March 11, 2026, Balikpapan has not been categorized as an endemic area nor triggered the Health Ministry’s Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI). Measles is highly contagious, with one case potentially infecting 12–18 susceptible individuals. Authorities are implementing a catch-up vaccination campaign to reach unvaccinated residents and ensure home isolation for infected individuals until recovery. Families of cases receive prophylaxis, and local health centers (Puskesmas) are notified to report contacts. A Lebaran/Eid al-Fitr travel advisory urges avoiding close contact with babies and maintaining hand hygiene to limit transmission. Aside from measles, Balikpapan reports prominent health issues including hypertension and acute respiratory infections (ARIs).

triage.headline_ja: バリクパパンで麻疹患者200人超、大多数がワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリクパパン市での麻疹集団発生（200例以上）で、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。高い感染力（R0=12-18）と大規模な未接種人口による流行リスクが認識されている。
triage.notes: バリクパパンはまだ風土病地域には分類されておらず、保健省の集団発生対応免疫化（ORI）は未発動。ただし200例超の報告と高い感染力、ワクチン接種率の低さから国際的な関心事項。レバラン期間中の旅行警告が発令されており、国際的な人口移動によるリスク拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Muncul di Pati, Menyerang Anak di Bawah 10 Tahun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Case Emerges in Pati, Affects Children Under 10.
article.articleSummary: Six confirmed measles cases detected in Pati Regency, East Java, Indonesia, in early 2026, across three subdistricts: Tayu (4), Tambakromo (1), and Sukolilo (1). Most patients are children under 10 years old. Common symptoms include high fever (38–40°C), persistent cough, runny nose, and red, light-sensitive eyes, with fatigue and poor appetite. After several days, a red rash appears, typically starting behind the ears and face and spreading to the neck, body, arms, and legs. Koplik spots may be present in the mouth. Health authorities urge prompt medical evaluation to prevent wider transmission. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, cough and sneeze etiquette, and avoiding direct contact with cases. Vaccination with MR or MMR is the most effective prevention; many patients reportedly had not received measles immunization, and vaccination campaigns via Pati’s community health centers are ongoing to close immunity gaps.

triage.headline_ja: パティ県で麻疹症例が出現、10歳未満の子どもを襲撃
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東ジャワ州パティ県で麻疹の6例確認、複数地区に分散、ワクチン接種率の低さが背景にある。麻疹は予防可能疾病であり、ワクチン未接種者の多さから感染拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 麻疹は通常、発展途上国で予防接種の地域的なギャップが存在する場合に流行しやすい。本事例では多くの患者がMR/MMRワクチン未接種であり、当局が予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。複数地区への分散は地域コミュニティでの感染拡大を示唆。小児患者が中心であることから学校伝播リスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad | বিয়ের প্রস্তাব বাতিল করায় প্রতিহিংসা! তরুণীর শরীরে এইচআইভি (HIV) সংক্রমিত রক্ত পুশ করে গ্রেপ্তার যুবক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hyderabad | Spite over canceled marriage proposal! Man arrested for injecting HIV-infected blood into a young woman's body.
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad's Pocharam IT Corridor saw a 24-year-old man allegedly forcibly inject HIV-infected blood into a 22-year-old woman after she rejected his marriage proposal. The incident occurred on 11 March at the woman's home. Police filed an Attempt to Murder case, and the suspect has been arrested. Reports indicate the accused is HIV-positive; the woman's HIV status is not specified. The motive, as described by investigators, appears to be a skewed belief that infecting her would compel lifelong marriage. The woman has been hospitalized and is receiving treatment, while authorities conduct further investigations into the circumstances and motive surrounding the attack.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード | 婚約破棄への報復！青年がHIV感染血液を女性の体に注射して逮捕
triage.triage_reason: 個別の犯罪事件としての性質が強く、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の流行の兆候ではない。ただし、被害者の感染確認と医学的経過観察が必要なため情報継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本事件は意図的な針刺し事故であり、感染症の自然発生的流行ではない。被害者のHIV感染確認状況が不明であるため、医学的予後を注視する必要がある。公衆衛生危機というより刑事事件として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Health talk: Be wary of measles, its a deadly disease
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a deadly, highly contagious viral disease despite vaccines. In 2018, more than 140,000 people died, predominantly in low-income countries with weak health systems. Top outbreak countries include Nigeria, India, Pakistan, Liberia, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, DRC, Indonesia and Ivory Coast. Zimbabwe reports 2,056 cumulative measles cases through Aug 15, with at least 157 deaths since April 2022. The World Health Organization warned Africa of a surge in preventable diseases due to vaccination delays; measles cases in Africa jumped by at least 400%. Measles presents with high fever, cough, runny nose, red watery eyes, and a rash; Koplik spots may appear 2–3 days after symptoms. Incubation 7–14 days. Children under five (and those over 20) are high risk. Unvaccinated children remain vulnerable; barriers include religious sects like Apostolic groups. Recommended actions: accelerate vaccination, improve vaccine supply/storage/transport, engage faith/traditional leaders, potentially mandating vaccination; robust case management.

triage.headline_ja: Health talk: Be wary of measles, its a deadly disease（健康談話：麻しんに注意、それは致命的な病気である）
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんは複数国での多発生と死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準で2項目以上該当。アフリカでの400%の症例増加とWHO警告があり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月15日付けだが、サマリーに2018年のデータ（140,000人死亡）とジンバブエの2022年4月以降のデータが混在している。複数国（ナイジェリア、インド、パキスタン、リベリア、エチオピア、アフガニスタン、インドネシア、コートジボワール、ジンバブエ）での同時多発が報告されており、ワクチン接種遅延による予防接種率低下が主因とされている。ワクチン接種率低下（特に宗教的障壁）と脆弱な保健システムの存在が管理性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: 'এইচআইভি পজিটিভ' বলে ভেঙেছে বিয়ে, 'বদলা' নিতে প্রেমিকার শরীরে সংক্রমিত রক্ত চালান যুবকের!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Broke off the marriage by declaring 'HIV-positive', a young man injected infected blood into his girlfriend's body to take revenge!
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India: A 24-year-old man with HIV-positive status attacked his fiancée after their engagement was cancelled due to his diagnosis. In September, the groom-to-be tested HIV positive, leading the fiancée’s family to call off the marriage; the two families were related, and the fiancée’s family initially agreed before reversing. Enraged, the man allegedly visited the victim’s home on March 11 and forcibly injected her with his own infected blood using a syringe. The woman is hospitalized with injuries. Police have arrested him and registered an attempted murder case; the investigation is ongoing. The suspect’s parents are HIV-positive, which prompted the decision to test the fiancé’s blood. The incident has shocked residents in the area.

triage.headline_ja: HIV陽性であると宣言されて結婚が壊れた。復讐のために若い男性が感染した血液を婚約者の体に注射した！
triage.triage_reason: 個人的な犯罪事件であり、感染症の異常な集団発生ではないが、意図的なHIV感染行為という公衆衛生上の異常なシナリオのため、追加情報により判定が変わる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 本件は刑事事件としての性質が強く、感染症の集団発生ではない。ただし意図的なHIV感染行為は公衆衛生上の異常な事象である。被害者の感染確認状況、その他の被害者の有無、治療体制の状況など追加情報により判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Horror: HIV-positive man injects infected blood into woman after wedding called off
article.articleSummary: A 24-year-old man was arrested in Hyderabad after allegedly injecting HIV-infected blood into a 22-year-old woman at her home on March 11, following the cancellation of their arranged marriage due to his HIV-positive status. Investigators say the victim and the accused are relatives; the families had agreed to marry, but concerns arose because the man’s parents were living with HIV. After a September last year medical test confirmed his status, the girl's parents called off the engagement. The accused allegedly attacked in revenge, believing the woman would be forced to marry him if she contracted the virus. The woman was rushed to hospital, where doctors are monitoring her condition. A case has been registered at Pocharam IT Corridor police station, charging the suspect with attempt to murder; investigation ongoing. Public outrage and stigma highlight the case.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード衝撃事件：HIV陽性男性、婚約破棄後に感染血液を女性に注射
triage.triage_reason: 意図的な感染伝播という異常かつ予想外の犯罪事件であり、重篤な個別事案として注視が必要。ただし、流行病学的リスク（広範な感染拡大の懸念）が低いため、フルRRA前段階として情報収集を継続する。
triage.notes: 本事案は意図的な害行為に基づく個別の刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の流行病学的リスク（ヒト-ヒト感染の広がり、管理不全地域への拡大）は認められない。被害者の治療経過については不明。インドの法執行機関が対応中であり、国際支援の必要性は現段階では不明。社会的・政治的な関心（スティグマ、HIV陽性者への差別）は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Status KLB, Dinkes Samarinda Pastikan 72 Kasus Baru Sebatas Suspek Medis - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not yet at outbreak status, Samarinda Health Office confirms 72 new cases as only suspected medical cases - Tribunkaltim.co.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 March 2026, Samarinda City Health Office in East Kalimantan reports 72 suspected measles cases, up from 62, with all samples undergoing laboratory testing at a reference lab. No laboratory-confirmed measles cases have been reported yet; status remains 'suspected' pending lab validation to confirm positivity. The majority of suspected cases involve children, many of whom are unvaccinated. Samarinda has not declared a Public Health Emergency of Outbreak (KLB). Authorities emphasize the need for laboratory confirmation to determine outbreak status. In response, the Health Office is implementing catch-up immunization (immunization kejar) for children who missed vaccines and intensifying Vitamin A supplementation for vulnerable groups, especially infants and toddlers. No infection source is identified, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 未だアウトブレイク状態ではなく、サマリンダ保健局は72の新規患者が医学的疑い例のみであることを確認 - Tribunkaltim.co
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の疑い例72件が報告され異常性あり（IHR基準2つ該当の可能性）が、実験室確認なく疑い例段階であり、現時点ではアウトブレイク宣言なし。続報による確認の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 実験室確認待ちの段階であり、確認例なし。主に未接種児童が影響を受けている。当局は予防接種追い上げとビタミンA補給対策を実施中。インドネシア国内の東カリマンタン州での地域限定的な報告のため、現時点では国際的拡大リスク低い。実験室結果の確認報告を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: রহস্যভেদ! জিনের ত্রুটিতেই ভয়ংকর রূপ নিয়েছিল কোভিড
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mystery Solved! COVID Took on a Dangerous Form Due to Genetic Defects.
article.articleSummary: In Kolkata, doctors link severe COVID-19 forms to genetic immune defects (Inborn Errors of Immunity). At the first East India conference on Inborn Errors of Immunity, Dr. Priyankar Pal and Dr. Jigna Vattiya said congenital immune defects can predispose individuals to dangerous COVID-19 outcomes, with some producing antibodies that undermine protective immune proteins. The Indian Society for Primary Immunodeficiency Disorders and an international body (IAPID) organized the event. They noted that IEIs are often diagnosed in newborns, presenting as frequent infections with only temporary relief from antibiotics. In Kolkata's Institute of Child Health, a five-year-old Bihar resident admitted with TB-like symptoms was diagnosed with Chronic Granulomatous Disease (CGD) after identifying Nocardia bacteria; no tuberculosis. Diagnostic tests highlighted elevated neutrophil counts or CRP, plus lymphocyte-subset analysis and genetic testing as key tools.

triage.headline_ja: 謎解き！遺伝子の欠陥によってCOVID-19が危険な形態を呈していた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医学的な仮説提示と個別症例報告であり、新規の疾病流行や公衆衛生危機を示すシグナルではない。COVID-19とTBの活動的な集団発生の証拠が示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容は、先天性免疫不全症（IEI）がCOVID-19の重症化に関与する可能性についての医学会議での専門家討議と、CGDの個別診断事例の報告である。公開医学情報の共有であり、新規流行やアウトブレイクの兆候ではない。配信日時が2026年3月であることに注意（将来日付）。

article.articleHeadline: हर बार ताकतवर होकर लौट रहा चिकुनगुनिया, AIIMS रिसर्च में चौंकाने वाला खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Returns Stronger Every Time, Shocking Revelation in AIIMS Research
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya resurges with a more aggressive variant, as reported by Dr. Sumit Rawat of Sagar Bundelkhand Medical College, in collaboration with AIIMS Bhopal. Drawing on India's 2006 nationwide outbreak and subsequent spikes in 2016 and 2024, the study identifies a new chikungunya variant associated with more severe disease. Infected patients may develop brain fever (encephalitis), heart inflammation, lung inflammation, immune suppression, dizziness, and prolonged joint pain. The findings originate from Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, with local coverage by 18 News, highlighting potential higher morbidity and the need for awareness and preventive measures. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources. Keywords: chikungunya, outbreak, Madhya Pradesh, encephalitis, myocarditis, pneumonitis, joint pain, coronavirus-free (not mentioned).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が毎回さらに強力になって戻ってくる、AIIMSの研究で衝撃的な真実が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の新規変異株がインド・マディヤプラデシュ州で検出され、より重症な脳炎や心筋炎などを伴う報告がある。IHR基準で異常性と重症度が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はAIIMS Bhopalの研究機関からの報告であり、信頼性は高い。ただし、検査確認の詳細や感染源については記事に明記されていない。チクングニア熱は2006年、2016年、2024年のアウトブレイク歴があり、現在の新規変異株がより重症化している点が重要。複数疾患（COVID-19、チクングニア、不明な脳炎）が同一地域で言及されており、さらなる情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: বিয়ে ভেঙে যাওয়ায় রাগ, বাড়িতে ডেকে নিজের রক্ত যুবতীর শরীরে ঢুকিয়ে দিলেন এইচআইভি আক্রান্ত যুবক!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An HIV-positive young man, angry over a broken marriage, called the young woman to his house and injected his own blood into her body!
article.articleSummary: An HIV-positive man in Hyderabad’s Pocharam ITI Police Station area lured a 22-year-old woman to his home after her family refused to approve the marriage. Following the woman's HIV-positive result, the suspect—also HIV-positive—allegedly injected his own blood into her body on March 11, resulting in the woman contracting HIV. Police filed a case of attempt to murder and arrested him; the woman is hospitalized. Investigators are examining whether others were involved. The incident is linked to the groom’s and his parents’ HIV status influencing the marriage decision. The case highlights risks of intimate-partner transmission and the use of infected blood as a weapon; authorities continue the probe.

triage.headline_ja: 結婚破談に怒り、自宅に呼び出した女性にエイズウイルス感染者が自分の血液を注射したハイデラバード事件
triage.triage_reason: HIVの意図的感染（血液注射）という異常かつ重大な刑事事件であり、IHR基準で2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と社会的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 本事件はHIVの意図的・悪意ある感染行為であり、刑事事件として警察が対応中。被害者は入院中。IHR基準の『公衆衛生への深刻な影響』および『異常・予想外』に該当し、さらにWPRO基準でも『異常性』『重症度』『管理可能性の不確実性』で複数該当するためPICKUPと判定。国内での感染拡大リスクは不明であるが、公衆衛生上の懸念と社会的関心の高さから継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 187 Suspek, Dua Positif, Makassar Siapkan Imunisasi Massal Waspadai KLB Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 187 Suspected, Two Positive, Makassar Prepares Mass Vaccination; Be On the Lookout for a Measles Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 15 March 2026, Makassar, South Sulawesi, reports a measles surge with 187 suspected cases and 2 laboratory-confirmed positives; hundreds of specimens are pending. Makassar is among 10 Indonesian districts/cities with a measles KLB for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), after 183 cases in 2025 in Makassar and 10 in Sinjai. The most affected are children 6 months–5 years, especially 9–24 months, often not fully immunized. Morbillivirus is highly contagious via droplets and can persist in air or on surfaces for up to two hours, with one case exposing about 12–18 others. Complications include pneumonia, diarrhea, encephalitis, otitis media, and malnutrition, with higher mortality in malnourished or immunocompromised children. Health authorities launched Outbreak Response Immunization in Makassar and Sinjai, while routine MR immunization (9 months, 18 months, and first grade) remains in effect. Seek care for fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 187人の患者疑い例、2人の確定患者、マカッサル市は麻しん集団発生に備え予防接種キャンペーンを準備
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんの確定患者と複数の疑い例が報告され、IHR基準では異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスクが該当。WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: インドネシア・スラウェシ南部で麻しんの多年にわたる集団発生（2025-2026年）が報告されている。マカッサル市では2025年に183例、2026年3月時点で187の疑い例と2つの確定例が報告されている。麻しんウイルスは極めて伝播性が高く（1症例が12-18人を曝露）、特に9-24ヶ月の予防接種不十分な児童が影響を受けている。複雑性（肺炎、脳炎等）と脆弱集団における高い死亡率が懸念される。当局は予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Seis anos após primeiro caso, covid-19 ainda provoca mortes na Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years after the first case, COVID-19 still causes deaths in Bahia.
article.articleSummary: Six years after the first Covid-19 case in Bahia, Brazil, COVID-19 deaths persist. Sesab reports five COVID-19–associated deaths in 2026. In early 2026, Bahia recorded 919 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, with 32 deaths; of these, five were due to COVID-19 and one to influenza; remaining deaths under investigation or attributed to other respiratory viruses. The data show continued circulation of both SARS-CoV-2 and influenza, though not at pandemic or emergency levels, with hospitalizations occurring. Vaccination remains key to reducing severe outcomes; keep immunizations up to date. Higher hospitalization risk for SRAG among children; deaths concentrated among elderly. The first Bahia COVID-19 death occurred 29 March 2020, a 74-year-old man in Salvador. Authorities emphasize vigilance and basic prevention, particularly for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 六年経ってもバイアではCOVID-19が死亡を引き起こし続けている
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とインフルエンザの継続的な循環が報告されているが、パンデミックまたは緊急レベルではなく、死亡数は限定的（2026年5例）。IHR基準は2つ以上該当していないため、詳細な情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は過去6年間のCOVID-19の遺産と継続的な循環について取り上げており、エルサルバドルが関連地域として記載されているが、記事本文がないため詳細な地理的範囲や影響は不明。現在の死亡率は制御範囲内であり、公衆衛生対策（ワクチン接種、基本的な予防策）が強調されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、WATCH判定で続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: 全球醫療創新：中國批准腦機介面設備，美國擴大呼吸道融合病毒疫苗適用範圍 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Healthcare Innovation: China Approves Brain-Computer Interface Devices, United States Expands Indications for Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccines | yam News
article.articleSummary: China grants first-ever commercialization approval for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) medical devices, developed by Borui Kang Medical Technology, to help paralyzed patients regain movement and communication. In the U.S., FDA widens GSK’s Arexvy RSV vaccine indications to adults 18–49 at high risk of severe respiratory disease, joining existing use for older adults. Stryker faces a cyberattack by Iranian hackers; Viatris and the Henrietta Lacks family settle a dispute over unauthorized use of cells. WHO confirms a strike on Burji Karaviye Medical Center in Lebanon amid intensified Israel–Hezbollah clashes, with 12 medical staff killed; in the last 24 hours, southern Lebanon reports 14 healthcare worker fatalities, and two more were killed earlier at Al Sowana clinic.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルヘルスケアイノベーション：中国が脳・コンピュータインターフェース装置を承認、米国が呼吸道融合病毒ワクチンの適用範囲を拡大
triage.triage_reason: RSV関連情報は複数国に関わるが、主流は医療技術イノベーション（BCI承認、ワクチン適応拡大）であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクではない。レバノンの医療施設攻撃は深刻だが紛争関連。情報不足により全体的な感染症公衆衛生リスク評価が困難。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容は：(1)中国のBCI医療機器承認（神経再生技術）、(2)米国FDA/GSK RSVワクチン適応拡大（成人18-49歳高リスク者）、(3)Stryker社へのサイバー攻撃、(4)レバノンでの医療施設攻撃と医療スタッフ死亡（紛争関連）。RSVワクチン適応拡大は既知技術の新規適応であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。レバノン医療施設への攻撃は感染症アウトブレイクではなく人道的危機。続報で実際の感染症状況の詳細が判明する場合に備えて継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Experimental HIV prevention drug shows rare infections
article.articleSummary: Lenacapavir (Yeztugo), a long-acting injectable HIV prevention drug, yields rare breakthrough infections reported at CROI 2026 in Denver. In PURPOSE I, >5,300 cisgender adolescent girls and young women in sub-Saharan Africa; among >2,000 injections, 2 HIV infections vs 77 in daily PrEP. In PURPOSE II, >3,000 men who have sex with men and gender-diverse individuals; 3 infections with Lenacapavir vs 12 on daily pills. Breakthrough infection rate ~0.07–0.11 per 100 person-years. Four of five breakthrough cases showed resistance mutations; researchers explore biological/pharmacokinetic explanations. Cost exceeds $28,000/year in the US, raising access concerns. Rollouts began February 2026 in Zimbabwe, South Africa, Zambia, Malawi, with Zimbabwe piloting February 19 in Epworth and ~46,000 doses; focus on 24 high-risk locations and groups such as adolescent girls and young women, sex workers, pregnant/breastfeeding women. Despite rare infections, protection nears 99%.

triage.headline_ja: Experimental HIV prevention drug shows rare infections
triage.triage_reason: 実験的HIV予防薬（Lenacapavir）の臨床試験結果報告であり、既知の医療介入の有効性評価に関するニュース。新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、または公衆衛生上の突発的危機を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医学会議（CROI 2026）での臨床試験結果の学術的報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。HIV予防薬の有効性評価（99%の保護率、0.07-0.11/100人年の突破感染率）に関する既知の医療情報。新規アウトブレイクや異常な疫学的パターンを示唆するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rijiju praises MPs vs Delhi Police T20 for 'TB Mukt Bharat' cause
article.articleSummary: TB Mukt Bharat awareness drive featured MPs versus Delhi Police in a T20 match at New Delhi’s Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium to promote TB elimination in India. The event is part of the Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan launched by President Droupadi Murmu on 9 September 2022, aiming to unite stakeholders for TB prevention and treatment. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju praised cross-party participation and parliamentary fitness, while BJP MP Anurag Thakur stressed TB defeat over who wins. The match is organized by the Constitution Club of India, continuing a Nehru-era tradition; last year’s edition saw actors defeat the MPs. The article centers on awareness and public engagement, with no clinical data or case counts reported.

triage.headline_ja: Rijiju praises MPs vs Delhi Police T20 for 'TB Mukt Bharat' cause
triage.triage_reason: 結核の認識向上キャンペーン（T20慈善試合）の報道であり、新規の感染症クラスター、アウトブレイク、または臨床的エスカレーションを示す証拠がない。公衆衛生への実質的な影響や国際的なリスクは認識されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核排除（TB Mukt Bharat）キャンペーンの認識向上イベントに関するものであり、病疫学的シグナルではない。政治的・慈善的関心は存在するが、疾病サーベイランスの観点からはシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Vészjelzés Kínából: újabb titokzatos légúti vírus terjed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning from China: another mysterious respiratory virus is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus in Pneumoviridae, closely related to RSV. First identified in the Netherlands in 2001, it now infects nearly all children by age five and circulates worldwide. In temperate regions, infections peak in winter and early spring; in tropical areas, transmission occurs year-round. HMPV spreads via respiratory droplets and direct contact, with a 3–6 day incubation. Symptoms mimic cold, influenza, or RSV infections and include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, and fatigue; severe cases may cause wheezing, shortness of breath, bronchitis, or pneumonia. Healthy adults usually have mild illness, but children <5 and adults ≥65, especially with chronic or immunosuppressive conditions, are at higher risk of hospitalization. No antiviral or vaccine exists; treatment is supportive. Prevention relies on hand hygiene and staying home when ill. Recent reports from North America, Asia, and China indicate substantial HMPV activity, sometimes exceeding seasonal influenza counts, with under-testing.

triage.headline_ja: 中国からの警告：別の謎めいた呼吸器ウイルスが拡散しています
triage.triage_reason: ヒトメタニューモウイルス（HMPV）は世界的に循環する既知の病原体であり、最近の活動報告がある一方で、新規性や異常性が限定的である。情報が記事サマリーの背景情報に依存しており、現在の中国での流行規模、重症度、対応能力に関する具体的データが不足している。
triage.notes: HPMVは2001年にオランダで初めて同定された既知の病原体であり、世界中で循環している。記事は「謎めいた」と表現しているが、実際にはよく特性化された呼吸器ウイルスである。中国での「最近の報告」があるとされるが、現在の流行規模、発症数、重症度、死亡率に関する具体的な数値データが提供されていない。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさが該当するが、IHR基準は該当しないため、フルRRAの前に続報を注視する段階と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: 2 kids succumb to rabies in Davao
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Davao City, Philippines, rose in early 2026 with two unvaccinated children aged 2 and 4 from Marilog District dying in February 2026. The city previously logged 3 rabies cases in 2024 and 6 in 2025, with two cases confirmed in February this year. Rabies remains preventable but deadly once symptoms appear; authorities urge immediate medical attention after animal bites or scratches. Anti-rabies vaccination campaigns persist, with 48,360 people vaccinated in 2024 and 48,433 in 2025, though vaccine shortages persist. The City Veterinary Office reports 27,637 animal vaccinations as of March 12, and anti-rabies operations are conducted within a one-kilometer radius of reported rabid animals. Public guidance includes proper first aid: wash wounds for 10–15 minutes, apply antiseptics, and proceed to the City ABTC for treatment; ABTC opens at 10 a.m. daily at the City Health Office.

triage.headline_ja: ダバオで2人の子どもが狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による小児死亡事例であり重症度は高いが、フィリピンは既知の狂犬病流行地域であり、事例は散発的で国際的な急速拡大のリスクは限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: フィリピン（ダバオ）は狂犬病の既知流行地。2024年3例、2025年6例、2026年初期にすでに複数事例が報告されており、地域的には継続的な流行状況。予防ワクチンと露後接種が実施されているが、ワクチン不足の報告あり。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域における管理可能性の詳細情報が不明であるため、WATCHとして続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Caramujo africano preocupa autoridades de saúde e meio ambiente - Jornal O+Positivo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African snail worries health and environmental authorities
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health and environmental authorities are monitoring the invasive African snail, Lissachatina fulica, across multiple regions due to environmental, agricultural, and public health risks. Originating in East Africa, it was introduced in the 1980s for snail farming; after farming failed, many specimens were released, enabling rapid spread. The species thrives in vacant lots, backyards, gardens, and debris and reproduces prolifically, laying hundreds of eggs. Besides ecological and crop damage, it can harbor parasites that cause human disease, including eosinophilic meningitis and abdominal angiostrongyliasis. Public guidance includes avoiding direct contact with the snail; if handling is necessary, wear gloves or use plastic bags and maintain clean, debris-free areas to curb proliferation. Monitoring is ongoing across Brazil as of 15 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカマイマイがブラジルの保健・環境当局を懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: 侵略的外来種による環境・農業・公衆衛生リスクが継続中だが、現時点では確認された人的被害や急速な国際拡大の直接的証拠がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: アフリカマイマイ(Lissachatina fulica)は既知の侵略的外来種であり、ブラジルでの継続的監視対象。寄生虫媒介による好酸球性髄膜炎とアニサキス症のリスクがあるが、記事からは現在の人的被害や確認症例が報告されていない。モザンビークも発生地域として列挙されているが詳細不明。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・長期曝露・流行性の3項目で肯定的だが、IHR基準では該当なし。追加情報による人的被害の確認または複数国への同時拡大確認でPICKUP判定への変更あり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Berau Catat 42 Suspek Campak Awal 2026, Mayoritas Anak Belum Divaksin - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Berau Health Office records 42 suspected measles cases in early 2026, most children have not been vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: As of the ninth week of 2026, Berau Health Office reports 42 suspected measles cases, with all cases still classified as suspects pending laboratory confirmation. Samples from Berau are routed first to the provincial level, then to the Balai Besar Teknik Kesehatan Lingkungan dan Pengendalian Penyakit (BBTKLPP) in Banjarbaru; if Banjarbaru is at capacity, specimens may be sent to Jakarta. Laboratory results can take up to two months. Despite awaiting lab confirmation, case management is initiated immediately based on doctors' diagnoses and medical teams' assessments to prevent deterioration. Most suspected cases are in Sambaliung District, and more than 80% involve individuals who were not vaccinated against measles, which is preventable by immunization (PD3I). Unvaccinated patients tend to present more severe symptoms and have higher risks of complications or death; measles mostly affects children, especially infants and toddlers, though adults can be affected.

triage.headline_ja: ベラウ保健局、2026年初頭に麻疹疑い症例42件を記録、ワクチン未接種児童がほとんど
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア複数州における麻疹疑い症例42件の集積報告であり、ワクチン接種率の低さ（80%以上が未接種）と重症化リスク、特に小児への影響が明確。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 麻疹は予防可能な感染症であるが、検査体制の制約（ジャカルタへの検体送付で最大2ヶ月の結果待ち）と高い未接種率が管理上の課題。複数州（カリマンタン東部、カリマンタン南部、ジャカルタ）に分散した発生パターン。実験室確認待機中も臨床診断に基づく即時管理が実施されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Sem adesão de moradores, Mirassol libera vacina da chikungunya para cidades vizinhas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lack of uptake among residents, Mirassol makes the chikungunya vaccine available to neighboring cities.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination campaign in Mirassol, Brazil, began February 2, with uptake lagging: fewer than 3,000 of a 37,000-person target (ages 18–59). Following Ministry of Health guidance (Nota Técnica 30/2026), Mirassol allows residents from other municipalities to be vaccinated if doses are available, reflecting regional mobility. The vaccine, developed by Valneva with Instituto Butantan and Funfarme, was approved by Anvisa in April 2025 and is deployed strategically in selected municipalities based on epidemiology, population size, and health network capacity. In 2024 Brazil reported 263,502 chikungunya cases and 246 deaths, underscoring vaccination importance. Mirassol posts operate Monday–Friday, 7:00–17:00; photo ID required. Eligible adults: 18–59; travelers to outbreak areas; not recommended for pregnant/nursing; immunocompromised; uncontrolled comorbidities; allergy to vaccine components. Disease is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; symptoms include fever, severe joint pain, headache, rash; complications can include chronic arthralgia.

triage.headline_ja: 住民の接種率が低迷、ミラッソル市がチクングニアワクチンを近隣都市に提供
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニアワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、2024年に26万超の症例と246死亡が報告された背景から公衆衛生上の関連性がある。ただし本記事自体は接種戦略の地域展開であり、新規発生や異常事象の報告ではなく、情報不足のため要経過観察段階としる。
triage.notes: 2024年のブラジルにおけるチクングニア症例（26万3,502件、246死亡）が背景にあり、公衆衛生的な重要性がある。本記事は接種キャンペーンの進行状況報告であり、新規疾病発生アウトブレイクではなく、ワクチン展開戦略の記事である。Aedes aegypti媒介の継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行易発性（epidemic_prone）が存在するが、即座のフルRRA対象とはしない。今後、症例増加や新規地域への拡大が報告された場合はPICKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Baza: российские туристы подхватили массовое отравление в отеле на Пхукете
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baza: Russian tourists have contracted mass food poisoning at a hotel in Phuket.
article.articleSummary: As of March 15, 2026, at least 13 Russian tourists staying at a Phuket hotel have fallen ill over the past two weeks with symptoms consistent with mass food poisoning: fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and conjunctivitis; a child in one family developed acute tonsillitis during the illness. Tourists suspect the resort's tap water, described as muddy and foul-smelling, as the source, noting that infection could occur not only through drinking water but also during washing or toothbrushing. This marks a second such outbreak at the same hotel in recent weeks. The report also notes that previously several Russians died on Phu Quoc island due to various infections. No official confirmation of the exact etiologic agent or public health response is provided in the report. The case cluster underscores ongoing health risks for travelers at resort destinations.

triage.headline_ja: バザ：ロシア人観光客がプーケットのホテルで集団食中毒に感染
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessとして複数の症状が報告され、水系感染の可能性があるが、病原体の確定診断がなく、公式な公衆衛生対応の情報が不足している。ただし複数国での発症者報告と環境要因（水質）が関与する可能性があるため、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 病原体が「Unknown Illness」と特定されておらず、症状（発熱、嘔吐、下痢、結膜炎）は多様。水系感染が疑われているが、公式な確認がない。同一ホテルでの2度目の発症クラスタという異常性と、環境因子（不衛生な水質）による継続的な曝露リスクが認識される。ロシア語媒体からの報道であり、英語圏での確認状況は不明。診断確定とより詳細な疫学情報の取得が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Массовое отравление российских туристов произошло на Пхукете
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass poisoning of Russian tourists occurred in Phuket.
article.articleSummary: At least 13 Russian tourists were affected at the MBC Condotel in Phuket, Thailand, reporting acute intestinal infection symptoms and conjunctivitis. Some developed fever and other food-poisoning symptoms; one family with a child experienced acute purulent tonsillitis. Respondents suggested tap water as the source, noting exposure during washing or brushing teeth rather than drinking. The incident follows a renewed mass poisoning of Russian travelers on Phuket, with a February outbreak reportedly affecting at least 19 people. Media sources (Baza Telegram channel; KP.RU) mention dirty ice in drinks as a possible cause for the earlier outbreak. The article provides no laboratory confirmation and treats the source as unproven; cases were ongoing as of 2026-03-15.

triage.headline_ja: プーケットでロシア人観光客の集団中毒事件が発生
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの集団発生で異常性が高く、国際観光地での多国籍患者発生、水系感染の可能性がある。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 疾患が「Unknown Illness」であり、急性腸感染、結膜炎、化膿性扁桃炎、発熱など症状が多様。2月の集団発生に続く再発生のため、継続的な調査が必要。水系感染の可能性が強く示唆されているが、検査室確認は記事に記載なし。国際観光地での発生のため、複数国への感染拡大リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Bárbara realiza 5,7 mil ações contra mosquito da dengue em 2026 - Novo Momento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Bárbara carries out 5,700 actions against Aedes aegypti in 2026 - Novo Momento
article.articleSummary: Santa Bárbara d'Oeste's Vigilance Department of Zoonoses reports intensified Aedes aegypti control to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. From January to March 11, 2026, 5,708 blocking-and-breeding-site visits were conducted across neighborhoods including Santa Rosa II, Jardim Pérola, Cidade Nova, Planalto do Sol, Parque Zabani, Conjunto dos Trabalhadores, Terras de São Pedro, 31 de Março, Jardim Batagin, Vila Grego, Residencial Furlan, Jardim Conceição, Jardim São Francisco, Jardim Santa Alice, Vista Alegre, Chácaras Beira Rio, and Cruzeiro do Sul. They found 6,987 water containers, with 263 containing Ae. aegypti larvae. Additional vector-control activities included 44,519 home visits, 2,710 portable nebulizations, 1,580 ovitrampas surveyed, and 3,097 maintenance actions on larvicidal stations, plus 5,890 vehicular biolarvicide applications. Community involvement is essential; residents should host health agents, seal and cover water storage, clean gutters and pools, and install screens. Suspected dengue symptoms warrant local health care at (19) 3463-8099.

triage.headline_ja: サンタバーバラが2026年にデング熱蚊に対して5,700件の対策活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的な蚊の防除対策活動の報告であり、現在の確認症例数、入院者数、死亡者などの深刻な公衆衛生影響の具体的データが記載されていない。ブラジル国内の通常の媒介蚊制御プログラムの一環として位置付けられ、異常事態ではなく管理可能な状況である。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊制御活動の進行状況報告であり、発生の報告ではない。Dengue、Zika、Chikungunyaは流行しやすい疾患（epidemic_prone=Yes）で、ブラジルでは常在地域（prolonged_exposure=Yes）だが、本記事では実際の症例数や疾病発生の急増が報告されていない。当該地域の公衆衛生当局が対策を実施できているため管理可能（manageability=No）と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: ข่าวจริง! การโดนเห็บกัด เสี่ยงทำให้สมองอักเสบจากไวรัส SFTSV เป็นเรื่องจริง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News! Tick bites can lead to encephalitis caused by the SFTSV virus — it's real.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-15, Thailand reports confirmed cases of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) caused by SFTSV transmitted by ticks and through contact with animals. The Institute of Neurology, Ministry of Public Health, confirmed the risk following verification by Thailand's Fake News Center that tick bites can cause encephalitis from SFTSV. Typical presentations include high fever, thrombocytopenia (low platelets), and elevated liver enzymes; some patients develop severe complications such as multi-organ failure or meningoencephalitis, which can be life-threatening. The case fatality rate among reported cases ranges from 5% to 28%. Transmission occurs via tick bites; not all tick exposures lead to severe disease. Ongoing awareness in Thailand about tick exposure and potential neurological complications is noted.

triage.headline_ja: 速報！マダニに咬まれるとSFTSVウイルスによる脳炎につながる可能性がある — これは本当だ
triage.triage_reason: SFTS確定症例の報告で重症度が高く（致死率5～28%）、神経症状を伴う複雑な病態が確認されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: タイの公式機関（神経学研究所・保健省）による確認報告で信頼性が高い。マダニを媒介とする動物からのウイルス伝播経路が特定されており、ベクター制御および公衆衛生対応が急務。SFTS自体は既知の感染症だが、脳炎併発症例の顕著な報告は地域内での疫学的重要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Após morte de indígena, Ministério da Saúde faz força-tarefa contra chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the death of an indigenous person, the Ministry of Health forms a task force to combat chikungunya in Dourados
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil prompts a federal response as the Ministry of Health forms a task force to combat the disease in indigenous villages about 250 km from Campo Grande. There are 150 confirmed chikungunya cases and one death of an indigenous woman in the municipality. On March 7 a cleanup was conducted, and from March 9–11 health teams treated 1,156 homes. Vector control teams found Aedes aegypti breeding sites in 589 residences (26% of visits), mainly in water tanks, garbage, and tires. The municipality argues that mosquito control and village health are federal responsibilities, while the Ministry says it is monitoring the Dourados Indigenous Reserve, installing ovitrampas (egg traps) and conducting health education. The task force will intensify measures to eliminate breeding sites and apply insecticides, with multiple agencies involved.

triage.headline_ja: 先住民の死亡を受け、保健省はドゥラードスでのチクングニア対策タスクフォースを設置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードスで150例の確認症例と先住民の死亡を伴うチクングニア疾患の集団発生。連邦政府のタスクフォース編成と公式対応が開始されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・予想外の死亡事例）およびWPRO基準（重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性の懸念）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 先住民人口への影響が強調されており、保健省が公式タスクフォースを編成している点は高い政治的関心を示唆。ネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の媒介蚊が確認され、1,156世帯の訪問で589世帯（26%）に繁殖地が見つかっており、継続的な曝露リスクが存在。2026年3月という最新のタイムスタンプを持つシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Россияне снова массово отравились в отеле Таиланда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were poisoned en masse again at a hotel in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Phuket, Thailand — 13 Russian guests at MBC Condotel were diagnosed with conjunctivitis and a gastrointestinal infection, with symptoms beginning in late February. Patients reported eye inflammation, vomiting/diarrhea, and high fever; symptoms align with rotavirus infection. Illness linked to tap water described as foul-smelling and turbid, with illness attributed to water exposure. Earlier in February, 19 Russians at the same hotel reported nausea and abdominal pains, suggesting a broader outbreak at the property. Diarrhea and vomiting have affected guests and other hotels, including foreigners; pharmacies reported heavy demand for medicines. No laboratory confirmation is cited in the report, and the article does not specify investigations or official findings. As of 2026-03-15, the situation involves a water-associated outbreak at a Phuket hotel with gastrointestinal illness and conjunctivitis."}{

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人がタイのホテルで再び集団中毒：ロタウイルス感染の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ロタウイルス感染の疑いと水系感染の可能性がスクリーニング基準で1つ以上該当するが、臨床検査確認の欠落と情報の限定性が大きく、さらなる確認情報が必要。
triage.notes: ロタウイルス感染とされているが、臨床検査による確認が記事に明記されていない。水系感染の疑いは根拠があるが、同一ホテル内での複数エピソード（2月19人、3月13人）はより広範なアウトブレイクの可能性を示唆。ロシア人観光客が主な患者層であることから社会的関心は高いと考えられる。タイ保健当局の公式確認情報の入手が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana's Bold Stride: Marching Towards TB-Free Panchayats by 2025 | Health
article.articleSummary: About 35% of Haryana's gram panchayats are eligible for TB-free certification in 2025 under the TB Mukt Panchayat initiative. The effort aims to eliminate tuberculosis through a tiered TB-free certification system, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on World Tuberculosis Day, March 24, 2023, in Varanasi. Sumita Misra, Additional Chief Secretary of the Haryana health department, confirmed the milestone, highlighting grassroots momentum. In 2023, Haryana awarded 574 bronze TB-free certifications; in 2024, certifications rose to 1,855, including silver levels. By 2025, 2,157 panchayats were eligible for certification, underscoring active local governance engagement in the TB elimination mission. The tiered system seeks to sustain TB-free status and strengthen locally delivered TB prevention, early detection, and treatment through community accountability and healthy rivalry among panchayats.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の大胆な一歩：2025年までにTB無料パンチャヤトへ向かって進む
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はハリヤナ州のTB撲滅キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規感染症シグナルではなく公衆衛生施策の実績報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核排除に向けた既存プログラム（TB Mukt Panchayat initiative）の進捗を報告するもので、新規の感染症シグナル（outbreak、異常発生、新規病原体など）ではない。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus mpox avança no Brasil e Ministério da Saúde faz recomendações urgentes à população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox virus spreads in Brazil as the Ministry of Health issues urgent recommendations to the public.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) spreads in Brazil, with urgent public guidance from the Ministry of Health. By March 2026, Brazil records about 88 confirmed mpox cases across multiple states, concentrated in large urban centers led by São Paulo; other affected states include Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Rondônia, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and the Distrito Federal. No deaths have been reported in 2026 to date. Transmission occurs mainly via close contact with infected people, especially through skin lesions, bodily secretions, or prolonged respiratory droplets; contaminated objects can also transmit the virus, and intimate contact (including sex) can facilitate spread. Symptoms include fever, body aches, swollen lymph nodes, and skin lesions evolving into blisters and crusts. The SUS remains prepared to diagnose and monitor suspected cases, with ongoing surveillance, guidance for health professionals, and public information campaigns. Key measures: avoid contact with lesions or contaminated objects, seek medical care for fever with rash, maintain hand hygiene, isolate suspected cases, and consult official sources; vaccination may be indicated for some priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpoxウイルスが拡大し、保健省が国民に緊急勧告を発出
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade I/IIがブラジルの複数州（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ等）で88症例報告され、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続的リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、及び国際的拡散懸念を示唆。IHR基準3項目該当、スクリーニング基準4項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事日付は2026年3月15日と未来年月であり、実データの妥当性に注意が必要だが、提供情報に基づく評価では複数州での急速な感染拡大、公式な公衆衛生勧告、ヒト-ヒト感染（特に親密接触）による継続的拡散リスクがあり、ラテンアメリカ内及び国際的な二次拡散リスクが懸念される。死亡報告なし（現在）。

article.articleHeadline: 警惕！广东疾控提醒：如有症状，请立即就医_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant! Guangdong CDC reminds: If you have symptoms, please seek medical attention immediately.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong CDC warns that dengue fever and chikungunya fever may enter active transmission as warm weather returns (Mar 15–17) in Guangdong, driven by Aedes mosquitoes. No case counts are provided. Travelers returning from Southeast Asia or South America should monitor for symptoms within 14 days of return. Early signs include fever; dengue may cause rapid high fever (≥39°C within 24 hours); chikungunya commonly presents with severe joint pain lasting weeks to months; rashes may occur after fever. If suspected, seek prompt medical care at fever clinics or emergency departments and inform clinicians of recent mosquito bites or travel history. Do not self-medicate with NSAIDs (ibuprofen, aspirin) before diagnosis due to bleeding risk. Prevent by removing standing water, ensuring screens or air conditioning, using insecticides, wearing light-colored long clothing, and applying DEET-containing repellents. Returned travelers with symptoms should seek care quickly.

triage.headline_ja: 警惕！広東疾控提醒：如有症状，请立即就医（注意！広東疾病管理センター警告：症状がある場合は直ちに医療機関を受診してください）
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデング熱の同時警告であり、公式な疾病管理機関による啓発情報として関心度は高いが、具体的な症例数や患者発生確認の明記がなく、予防警告の性質が強いため情報不足。
triage.notes: 広東省疾病管理センターによる公式警告であり、暖かい季節到来に伴うデング熱およびチクングニア熱の活発化の可能性を指摘。ネッタイシマカによる媒介が懸念される。ただし、現在の患者発生数や確認事例に関する具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、予防啓発的な性質が強い。東南アジアおよび南米からの帰国者向けの注意喚起があり、国際的な関心も存在。継続的な情報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 72 Kasus Suspek Campak di Samarinda, Dinkes Tegaskan Belum Status KLB - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 72 Suspected Measles Cases in Samarinda, Health Office Says It Has Not Yet Declared an Outbreak
article.articleSummary: 72 suspected measles cases reported in Samarinda City, East Kalimantan, Indonesia, as of 2026-03-15. Cases have not been laboratory-confirmed yet; samples are undergoing tests at a reference laboratory, and no confirmed measles case has been declared. The rise follows reports of symptoms compatible with measles, with the majority of affected individuals not yet vaccinated. In response, Samarinda Health Office is implementing a catch-up immunization program to vaccinate unprotected children and is providing vitamin A to strengthen immunity in infants and toddlers. Ongoing surveillance and preventive measures are emphasized until laboratory confirmation determines whether measles is confirmed or not, with no outbreak declaration at this time.

triage.headline_ja: サマリンダで麻疹疑い患者72例、保健所は依然として流行宣言なしと確認
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の疑い患者72例という相応の患者数が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、実験室確認が未実施で確定患者がないため、現段階では情報不足。続報による確定状況の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹の疑い患者72例は重要な数値だが、実験室確認待機中であり確定患者ゼロ。ワクチン接種歴不十分な集団が主に罹患し、予防接種キャッチアップとビタミンAプログラムが実施中。インドネシア・カリマンタン東部地域での局所的事象。確定診断結果と患者数推移に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: تتغذى على دماء البشر.. البعوض يهدد الملايين بسبب تدمير غابات البرازيل - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The mosquito feeds on human blood... The mosquito threatens millions due to the destruction of Brazil's forests - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Deforestation-driven biodiversity loss in Brazil's Atlantic Forest is pushing some mosquito species to rely more on human blood, increasing potential disease transmission to nearby populations. A study by Oswaldo Cruz Institute (Rio de Janeiro) and the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, conducted in two protected reserves in Rio de Janeiro State, collected mosquitoes with light traps and used laboratory DNA analysis of blood meals to identify feeding sources. Results show a large share of meals from humans rather than wildlife, correlating with reduced biodiversity due to habitat destruction. The feeding shift could elevate transmission risk of arboviruses such as yellow fever, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Researchers emphasize that preserving ecosystem diversity and environmental protections may mitigate these risks in the future.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの森林破壊によるデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、黄熱病媒介蚊の人血嗜好性増加と感染リスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介性アルボウイルス4疾患の同時発生可能性と媒介蚊の行動変化を示すシグナルだが、具体的な患者発症報告やアウトブレイク確認がなく、現段階では環境・生態学的リスク分析であるため情報不足。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は学術研究成果の報告であり、アウトブレイク確認ではない。4つの重要蚊媒介性疾患（黄熱病、デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）が同時に言及されており、ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ地域での生態学的リスク評価は高い。ただし実際の患者発症数、死亡数、流行状況に関する具体的データが欠落している。続報で実患者発症の報告があればPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Estado segue com ações de monitoramento à gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State continues with monitoring actions for avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: First detection of avian influenza in wild birds reported in late February at the Taim Ecological Reserve, Rio Grande do Sul. By March 12, 2026, 23 birds—coscoroba swans and garça-moura (a type of heron)—were collected with the disease. The DDA/Seapi trained 186 health and social-service agents and held meetings with municipal managers in Rio Grande, Santa Vitória do Palmar, and Chuí to align prevention and control. Aimed at surveillance and containment, authorities conducted a sanitary sweep around the outbreak, inspecting 93 subsistence poultry properties within 10 km, plus commercial farms in the Pelotas area and ornament bird breeders in Santa Vitória do Palmar. In integrated action with ICMBio and Mapa, SVO-RS monitors Lagoa da Mangueira, collecting samples sent to LFDA-SP (OMSA reference) for confirmation. Suspect cases (respiratory or neurological signs, high mortality) should be reported via Inspetorias or e-Sisbravet or WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033.

triage.headline_ja: 州は鳥インフルエンザの監視活動を継続
triage.triage_reason: 野生鳥類からの鳥インフルエンザ検出（2月下旬）が確認され、監視体制が構築されている。人への感染報告はなく、現在のところ鳥類・環境への影響に限定されているため、続報による人への感染リスク確認が必要。
triage.notes: 野生鳥類（コスコロバハクチョウ、サギ類）での鳥インフルエンザ検出は予想外。ブラジル国内での検査体制（LFDA-SP、OMSA参照機関）が機能し、当局による積極的な監視・封じ込めが実施中。人への感染事例の報告はないが、鳥類ウイルスの継続的な流行リスクと接触労働者への曝露リスクから、今後の人への感染報告に注視が必要。IHR基準は人への深刻な影響が明記されていないため、現段階ではWATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por repunte de fiebre amarilla en América; casos aumentan más de cinco veces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of yellow fever resurgence in the Americas; cases have risen more than fivefold.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever resurges in the Americas, with the World Health Organization urging enhanced prevention and surveillance. In 2025, 346 human cases and 143 deaths were reported across seven countries, a 5.6-fold rise from 2024’s 61 cases. In weeks 1–7 of 2026 (Jan–Feb), 34 cases and 15 deaths were recorded regionwide. Brazil leads current totals (120 cases, 48 deaths), followed by Colombia (125 cases, 46 deaths); Bolivia has 1 death, Peru 2 cases, and Venezuela 6 cases (1 death). Colombia alone reported 25 cases (including 13 deaths) in weeks 1–7, with Venezuela, Peru and Bolivia contributing additional cases. Cases have begun appearing outside the Amazon basin, signaling geographic spread beyond traditional foci. Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne virus; severe illness can cause liver and kidney failure and severe bleeding, with up to ~50% case fatality. Vaccination, strengthened surveillance, and preventive measures are urgently urged.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、南米での黄熱病の再燃を警告。症例が5倍以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つすべてに該当。黄熱病の5.6倍の症例増加、多数国への国際的拡大、高い死亡率（CFR～50%）、ワクチン接種義務のある地域への地理的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 2025年に346例、143死亡（前年比5.6倍増）。2026年1-2月の34例、15死亡を含む現在の流行。8か国（ブラジル120例/48死亡、コロンビア125例/46死亡を含む）への広域拡大が確認。アマゾン盆地外への地理的拡散は国際的なリスク管理の観点から重要。カナリア諸島への関連言及はスペイン経由の輸入例の可能性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 6 Anak di Pati Positif Campak, Terbanyak di Kecamatan Tayu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six Children in Pati Test Positive for Measles, the Most in Tayu District
article.articleSummary: Six measles cases detected among children under 10 in Pati Regency, Indonesia, with four cases in Tayu District and one each in Tambakromo and Sukolilo, as of March 2026. Data from Dinkes Kabupaten Pati indicate infections likely among unvaccinated youngsters. Classic symptoms include high fever 38–40°C, persistent cough, runny nose, red eyes, fatigue, and loss of appetite, followed by a rash that begins behind the ears and face and spreads to the neck, body, arms, and legs. Koplik spots in the mouth are highlighted as a hallmark. Health officials anticipate ongoing transmission and plan to intensify vaccination campaigns to curb spread. No laboratory confirmation details beyond health office data; no fatalities reported in the article. Emphasizes vaccination to prevent further outbreaks in the district and province.

triage.headline_ja: パティで麻疹6人の小児が陽性、タユ地区で最多
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パティ県で麻疹の小児集団発症（6例）が報告され、未接種児との関連が示唆されている。麻疹は予防接種で対策可能な感染症であり、異常性・公衆衛生への影響・地域的拡大リスク・流行のしやすさがいずれも該当するため、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い伝播性を持つ感染症であり、未接種児集団での発生は地域的・潜在的に広域的な拡大リスクをもたらす。保健当局が予防接種キャンペーン強化を計画していることから管理可能性への懸念も認められる。今後の症例増加の可能性があるため、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: AP to Launch Statewide FMD Vaccination Drive
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination drive launched statewide in Andhra Pradesh for cattle and buffaloes from March 16 to April 29 under the National Animal Disease Control Programme. The free, door-to-door campaign will cover all animals over four months of age, in two phases: March 16–April 14 and April 15–29 to administer booster doses. Officials have distributed 8.37 million vaccine doses across districts. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease threatening livestock and farmers’ livelihoods; cross-bred cattle are especially susceptible, while indigenous breeds fare better. Infected animals may show high fever, mouth and hoof blisters, udder swelling, excessive salivation, and difficulty walking; calves face higher death risk, milk production declines, and pregnant animals may abort. Vaccination aims to avert economic losses, with Director of Animal Husbandry T. Damodar Naidu urging farmers to cooperate.

triage.headline_ja: AP to Launch Statewide FMD Vaccination Drive（アンドラプラデシュ州が州全域の口蹄疫ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始）
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾患であり、人間への感染リスクはない。記事は予防的なワクチン接種プログラムの実施を報告しており、疾病の急性発生や公衆衛生上の危機を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり、人間への直接的な感染リスクがない。IHR(2005)では人間の健康に関連する疾患を対象としており、この動物疾患は該当しない。記事は既存の国家動物疾病管理プログラムの一環として予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しているため、危機的シグナルとは判定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti e ultrapassa 197 mil imóveis vistoriados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá steps up the fight against Aedes aegypti and surpasses 197,000 inspected properties in 2026.
article.articleSummary: In Cuiabá, Brazil, health surveillance intensifies Aedes aegypti control with 197,192 properties inspected in early 2026 (latest epidemiological bulletin updated March 12, 2026). Vector teams treated 21,672 properties, 24,344 water containers, and eliminated 6,559 breeding sites. Dengue shows 323 notified cases with 139 confirmed; incidence 14.4/100,000. Chikungunya has 59 notifications and 58 confirmations. Zika remains at 4 notifications with no confirmed cases. One dengue death has occurred in 2026. Compared to 2025, dengue notifications fell 79.2% and chikungunya 99.3%. Dengue vaccination is available in the public network for 10–14-year-olds (two-dose schedule). Residents are urged to remove standing water, avoid self-medication for fever or body pains, and seek health units for evaluation; cooperation during home visits is essential.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ、ネッタイシマカとの戦いを強化し、2026年に197,000件以上の物件を検査
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マト・グロッソ州クイアバでデング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱の複合感染が報告されている。ただし、全体的には過去1年比での病例数が大幅に減少（デング79.2%減、チクングニア99.3%減）しており、現在の活動は予防的なベクトル対策に焦点が当たっているため、急速な国際的拡大リスクは不明瞭。より詳細な情報と動向追跡が必要。
triage.notes: ネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）媒介の複合感染（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）が報告されている。ただし病例数は前年比で大幅に減少傾向であり、地域当局によるベクトル対策が活発化している。デング1死亡例が報告されているが、全体的な重症度評価に基づいて判定。WATCHレベルで続報監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Menina Yanomami de 1 ano com desnutrição morre por verminose durante remoção aérea para Boa Vista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1-year-old Yanomami girl with malnutrition dies from a worm infection during an airlift to Boa Vista.
article.articleSummary: A 1-year-11-month-old Yanomami girl from the Xitei community in the Yanomami Indigenous Territory (spanning Amazonas and Roraima) died on Saturday while being airlifted to Boa Vista. The infant, who weighed 6.1 kg, suffered severe malnutrition, malaria, and intestinal parasitosis (ascariasis) and developed respiratory failure with Loeffler syndrome during the flight, with dehydration signs noted. The evacuation was requested around 10:29 and occurred about six hours later, around 16:20; she died around 17:30 as the aircraft approached Boa Vista. The body was returned to the community on Sunday. Health authorities (Dsei-Y and the Ministry of Health) monitor the case amid a broader Yanomami health emergency since January 2023, with indigenous leaders blaming delays and resource gaps in delivering care inside the territory, amid reports of ongoing illegal mining and prior child deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 1歳のヤノマミ先住民の女児が栄養失調と寄生虫感染で、ボア・ビスタへの空輸中に死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのロライマ州・アマゾナス州におけるマラリア関連の死亡事例。栄養失調、マラリア、腸内寄生虫症の複合感染による乳幼児死亡であり、2023年1月から続く先住民ヤノマミの保健危機の一部を示しており、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）およびWPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・管理可能性）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例は孤立した死亡例ではなく、2023年1月から継続する先住民ヤノマミの健康危機の一部。違法採掘、医療資源の不足、遠隔地での医療アクセス困難が背景にあり、公衆衛生上・政治的に高い関心事。複数の感染症（マラリア、腸内寄生虫症）と栄養失調の複合例であり、同地域での他の脆弱層への継続的なリスク曝露が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: BREAKING NEWS: 11 Warga di Kelurahan Manumutin Kabupaten Belu NTT Digigit Kucing Positif Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BREAKING NEWS: 11 Residents in Manumutin Urban Village, Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Bitten by Rabies-Positive Cats
article.articleSummary: On 15 March 2026, 11 residents of RT 12 RW 03, Manumutin Village, Atambua City Subdistrict, Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, were bitten by a cat confirmed positive for rabies. The cat has been captured and tested by Labkeswan Dinas Peternakan Belu, yielding a rabies-positive result. Three people were bitten on 14 March, with eight additional victims affected on the afternoon of 15 March. All were taken to a puskesmas for medical treatment and vaccination; nine have begun rabies vaccination, while two—due to hypertension—will be vaccinated the next morning. BPBD Belu coordinated with the Dinas Peternakan, Dinas Kesehatan, camat and lurah to document exposures and ensure vaccination coverage. The Rabies Working Team will vaccinate animals in Manumutin to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：東ヌサテンガラ州ベル県マヌムティン地区で狂犬病陽性猫に11人が咬傷
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病確定例による多数の咬傷被害（11人）、確定診断済み動物源感染、迅速な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・重症度）、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命率99%以上の重篤疾患。本件は確定診断された動物源感染で、複数の人的被害、確定診断済み、地域の公衆衛生当局が既に対応を開始している。ワクチン接種が迅速に実施されており、管理可能性あり。インドネシア国内でのシグナルとして重要。国際拡大リスクは低いが、動物狂犬病の地域的な管理状況モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Menghadapi Orang Tua Antivaksin di Tengah Wabah Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing anti-vaccine parents amid a measles outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks intensify across Indonesia in 2025–early 2026 amid antivaccine debates. The Health Ministry urged families to delay homecoming travel if children show measles symptoms. In 2025, Indonesia recorded 63,769 suspected measles cases, 11,094 laboratory-confirmed cases, and 69 deaths, with suspected cases rising about 147% from the previous year. In early 2026, the Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) reported 379 confirmed measles cases in the first five weeks, while suspected cases remained in the thousands and laboratories were backlogged. There were 45 measles outbreaks (KLB) across 29 districts in 11 provinces. The report notes severe pediatric illness, including bronkopneumonia/pneumonia and high fever with rapid breathing; a 7-month-old infant who could not be vaccinated was affected. Public debate targets antivaccine parents; calls for more voices from vaccinated mothers. A boundary-setting approach—excluding unvaccinated children from playgroups—is proposed to shield others.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹流行の中で反ワクチン親に対峙する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで2025年-2026年初頭にかけて麻疹流行が深刻化しており、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」の3項目に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡69名、重篤な小児疾患）、流行のしやすさ（未接種児童の増加、ワクチン接種率低下）、管理可能性（実験室の処理能力不足）が確認され、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 2025年の麻疹疑い患者数は63,769例（前年比147%増）、確認例は11,094例、死亡69例。2026年初5週間で確認例379例。29地区11州で45件のアウトブレイク（KLB）が発生。反ワクチン運動による接種率低下が流行を加速させており、ワクチン接種が困難な乳児（生後7ヶ月）も被害を受けている。保健省は帰郷時の移動制限を推奨し、政府の対応が開始されている。地域・国際レベルでの支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 chicken pox cases reported in Ernakulam in 2026
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox remains active in Ernakulam district, Kerala, with over 900 cases reported since January 2026. Across Kerala, 1,897 cases were recorded in March 2026 alone, bringing the year-to-date total to 11,388. Three deaths statewide this year. Doctors say no surge, but cases align with the summer season. Transmission is airborne and can occur even before vesicles appear; patients with fever should isolate and seek medical care promptly. Lesions typically begin on the trunk (torso, chest, stomach, back) and can be numerous, itchy, with fever and body aches. Vulnerable groups—adolescents, adults, and those with low immunity such as cancer or diabetes patients—are at higher risk of complications. Vaccination is advised for at-risk individuals to prevent severe disease; clinicians emphasize early care and public vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エルナクラムでチキンポックス900件以上が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 水痘（水疱瘡）の地域的な増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、情報が部分的に限定的（記事本文なし、詳細な感染経路・年齢別データ欠落）であるため、続報を注視する段階が適切。
triage.notes: ケーララ州エルナクラム地区で水痘の継続的な流行が観察されている。2026年1月以来900件以上、3月だけで1,897件、年間累計11,388件、州内で3例の死亡。記者の「サージはない」との判断と季節性の指摘がある一方、脆弱層（思春期以上の青年・成人、免疫低下者）に合併症リスクがある。記事本文が提供されておらず、個別事例の重症度、特定の年齢層・施設での集中化、医療体制への負荷などの詳細情報が不足しているため、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
