article.articleHeadline: Médico e ex-governador do Acre alerta para circulação da Febre do Nilo Ocidental no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A physician and former governor of Acre warns about the circulation of West Nile fever in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever circulates in Brazil, per a SBMT bulletin shared by Tião Viana, physician and former governor of Acre. The virus shows evidence of circulation in multiple Brazilian regions over the past decade, with 110 probable or confirmed cases reported in 13 states from 2014–2024, indicating ongoing activity but a low rate of clinical diagnoses. A recent confirmed case in Mato Grosso involving a baby rekindled debate about the virus’s presence in the country. West Nile fever is an arbovirus transmitted mainly by Culex mosquitoes, with birds as natural reservoirs; humans and other mammals are incidental hosts. About 80% of infections are asymptomatic; others present with fever and body pains, and rare cases may involve neurological complications. The SBMT calls for continuous surveillance and mosquito-control measures, emphasizing vigilance rather than an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州の医師・前知事がブラジルでの西ナイルウイルス熱の流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: 西ナイルウイルスはブラジルで確認されているが、過去10年間で110例の患者数は低い水準であり、現在のところ流行状況ではなく継続的な流行性は限定的。情報が部分的であり、国際的拡大リスク、旅行制限リスクについては不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: 西ナイルウイルスはブラジルに定着している蚊媒介感染症であり、継続的な曝露リスクと流行しやすさの基準を満たす。しかし患者数が限定的（2014-2024年で110例）であり、記事では「流行ではなく警戒を強調」とされている。前知事による警告など一定の社会的・政治的関心はあるが、国際的な緊急性の指標や管理可能性については情報不足。継続的な監視が必要な状況と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Statewide free FMD vaccination drive for cattle and buffaloes begins
article.articleSummary: Andhra Pradesh launches statewide free vaccination drive against Foot-and-Mouth Disease for cattle and buffaloes, including calves over four months, under the National Animal Disease Control Programme. Campaign runs March 16–April 29, 2026, in two phases: main round March 16–April 14 and second phase April 15–29, with vaccines administered at owners' homes free of charge. State has supplied 83.69 lakh vaccine doses to districts for the campaign. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle and buffaloes; cross-bred animals are more vulnerable. Vaccination is described as the only effective preventive measure. Transmission occurs via wounds, contaminated fodder, feed, water, dung, and urine of infected animals. Symptoms include fever 104-106°F, mouth and lip blisters, excessive salivation, hoof and udder blisters causing lameness. Calves may die after consuming milk; pregnant animals may abort; recovery can take up to six months. Economic losses loom due to milk decline and reduced work capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 牛と水牛を対象とした州全域の無料口蹄疫（FMD）予防接種キャンペーンが開始
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜に極めて高い伝播性を持つウイルス性疾患であり、経済的影響も大きいが、本イベントは予防接種キャンペーン開始という制御措置であり、新規発生報告ではない。人への影響やヒト-ヒト感染リスクに関する情報が不足しており、ヒトの健康への直接的な脅威度判定に迷いがある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは既存の動物疾患管理プログラムの一部としての予防接種キャンペーン開始報告である。新規発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。口蹄疫は家畜に対する高い伝播性と経済的影響が確認されるが、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響度が記事に不明確である。口蹄疫はヒト感染の報告は稀だが、農業従事者への職業上の曝露リスクは存在する。州政府による組織的対応（予防接種キャンペーン）が実施されており、管理可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Peternakan Belu Pastikan Kucing yang Gigit 11 Warga Manumutin Positif Rabies - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belu Department of Animal Husbandry confirms rabies-positive cat that bit 11 residents of Manumutin
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, after a cat that bit 11 residents in Manumutin, Atambua City District. Brain examination at a veterinary laboratory confirmed rabies, following a rapid test by a veterinary health doctor. The cat has been captured; authorities are coordinating with BPBD Belu and local officials to curb spread. On 16 March 2026, a Dinas Peternakan dan Perikanan working group will conduct a sweep for unvaccinated rabies reservoir animals (cats and dogs) and carry out comprehensive vaccination. Of the 11 bitten, nine have received post-exposure vaccination at a Puskesmas; two with hypertension have not yet been vaccinated. Rabies vaccine stock remains around 18,000 doses; a third round of vaccination is planned for May 2026. Residents are urged to report aggressive dogs or cats and vaccinate pets.

triage.headline_ja: ベル県動物畜産局がマヌムティン住民11人を咬んだ狂犬病陽性猫を確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで狂犬病の確認症例（猫）による11人の咬傷被害が発生。2人がまだ曝露後ワクチンを受けていないため、有効な治療と予防対策が急務。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・重症度・管理課題）およびWPRO基準複数該当のためシグナル認識。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%で、咬傷後の曝露後予防が重要。11人中9人は既にワクチン接種済みだが、高血圧患者2人の接種遅延が懸念される。地方当局が迅速に対応（ワクチン備蓄18,000用量、5月追加接種予定）しており、管理可能性は比較的高い。しかし狂犬病の高リスク性と管理上の課題から、継続的な経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 广东男子喝"生猪血"，半年后肢体抽搐、口吐白沫，失去意识...竟是寄生虫在头部安家！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Guangdong man drinks "raw pig blood," six months later experiences limb convulsions, foaming at the mouth, and loses consciousness... it turns out a parasite has taken up residence in his head!
article.articleSummary: A Guangdong man from Shanwei drank raw pig blood and, six months later, developed seizures, foaming at the mouth, and loss of consciousness. Brain MRI initially raised concern for a tumor, but after excluding neoplasms and vascular disease and considering dietary exposure, doctors diagnosed cerebral neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium cysticerci entering the central nervous system via bloodstream. The patient, in his 30s and who had worked in Zhejiang, underwent workup in Guangzhou and Guangzhou before treatment in Hangzhou. At Shulan Hospital (Hangzhou) Infectious Diseases Department, led by Dr. Gao Haina, his right frontal lobe lesion and intracranial edema progressively shrank with targeted therapy over six months, with symptoms resolving. A follow-up in March 2026 confirmed improvement. He was advised to avoid raw pig blood, highlighting the infection risk from undercooked pork products and the lack of an outbreak-like situation.

triage.headline_ja: 広東男性が生豚血を飲用、半年後に四肢痙攣・口から白い泡を吐出、意識喪失...頭部に寄生虫が住み着いていた！
triage.triage_reason: 神経嚢虫症の散発症例であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当せず。ただし異常な臨床症状と食品安全関連の文脈から継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例の臨床記録であり、アウトブレイクの兆候なし。感染源は生豚血摂取という明確な食品由来の曝露。タエニア・ソリウム（豚条虫）による神経嚢虫症は典型的な寄生虫病だが、中国の医療機関で既に診断・治療されており、対応可能。社会的関心は中国メディア報道により高いと考えられるが、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の即時対応要求は低い。続報で類似症例の集積がないか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão intersetorial de combate à dengue já alcança mais de 13 mil moradores em Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intersectoral mobilization to combat dengue has already reached over 13,000 residents in Cuiabá.
article.articleSummary: Intersectoral mobilization in Cuiabá, Brazil, targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city’s SMS-led task force plans to cover 53 neighborhoods and about 83,836 properties, with ~285 Endemic Disease Control Agents and support from Community Health Agents. Initiated on February 24, 2026, and running through May 5, 2026 (39 days), the campaign operates four days per week, weather permitting. To date, eight neighborhoods have been served, reaching ~13,237 residents with guidance, property inspections, and removal of standing-water sources. Early areas: Planalto, Novo Terceiro, Coophamil, 1º de Março, Parque Atalaia, Bela Vista, Cidade Alta, José Pinto. The “Ação Única” strategy combines ACEs and ACSs in a single visit to address all sanitation needs. Remaining neighborhoods include Três Barras, Jardim Liberdade, Novo Colorado, among others. After neighborhood completion, Primary Health assumes ongoing family and property monitoring to prevent reintroduction; public participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策の部門横断的動員がクイアバで13,000人以上の住民にすでに到達
triage.triage_reason: これは既知の蚊媒介性ウイルス感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア）に対する予防的キャンペーン報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な発生状況ではない。制御活動の進捗報告であり、公衆衛生上の新たなリスク信号を示していない。
triage.notes: 本報道は蚊媒介性感染症の定期的な予防対策キャンペンの進捗状況報告であり、新規患者発生、異常な流行、または緊急の公衆衛生問題を示す情報はない。ブラジルにおけるデング熱等への対策は継続的に実施されており、この報道は当該対策の効果的な展開を示している。シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : amélioration de la situation du choléra à la prison de Makala, 187 guérisons enregistrées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Improvement in the cholera situation at Makala Prison, 187 recoveries recorded
article.articleSummary: Cholera remains active in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, but conditions are improving after authorities’ measures. In Kinshasa province, about 240 new suspected cholera cases and deaths were reported; 84 active patients are treated in cholera centers, up from 41 a week earlier. At Makala Central Prison, six active cholera cases are hospitalized; total recoveries reach 187 and five deaths have been recorded since Feb 12, 2026. The INRB confirmed 13 positive cases from 17 samples; among confirmed, four recovered and five deaths. Fifteen new suspected cases were identified on Feb 13, 2026. A Feb 14 circular by Justice Minister Guillaume Ngefa Atondoko Andali bans new admissions to Makala, tightens visits, and orders strengthened sanitation, medicines, disinfection, and daily epidemiological reporting in coordination with the Health Ministry. Mpox: in week 9, suspected cases rose from 258 to 285; since 2024, 123,762 suspected and 34,822 confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：マカラ刑務所のコレラ状況が改善、187人の回復が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国でのコレラとMpoxの同時流行、刑務所での集団感染、死亡者報告があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（WPRO地域外ながら）でのコレラとMpoxの二重流行が報告されている。刑務所という高リスク環境での集団感染、死亡者5名の報告、確定患者の存在、政府による緊急措置（新規入所禁止、面会制限、衛生対策）が講じられており、重大な感染症危機の指標。Mpoxも症例数が増加傾向（258→285例）で、並行監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá registra mais de 300 notificações de dengue; veja como evitar o mosquito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá records more than 300 dengue notifications; see how to prevent the dengue-carrying mosquito.
article.articleSummary: In early 2026, Cuiabá recorded 323 dengue notifications with 139 confirmed, a 79.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. Chikungunya showed 59 notifications with 58 confirmed, down 99.3% in Q1, while Zika had 4 notifications with no confirmed cases. The reductions follow intensified Aedes aegypti control efforts across the city. From January to March 2026, 197,192 properties were inspected by Endemic Combat Agents; 21,672 required direct treatment, 24,344 water-containing deposits were treated, and 6,559 mosquito breeding sites were eliminated. Prevention guidance emphasizes removing standing water from containers, sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters and drains, using repellents as directed, and allowing endemic-control agents access for inspections. The measures target multiple Cuiabá neighborhoods to curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバがデング熱の300件以上の通知を記録；蚊を避ける方法を確認
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時発生が報告されており、2025年同時期との比較で減少傾向が見られるが、依然として相当数の通知件数と確定例があるため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月15日時点の情報。デング熱123確定例、チクングニア58確定例、ジカ0確定例が報告されている。前年同時期比で大幅な減少が記録されており、蚊の繁殖地除去など防除対策が実施されている。現在のところ、IHR基準2つ以上の該当は見られず、国際的拡大リスクや重篤度についての情報が不足しているため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: São Paulo registra 1º caso em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: São Paulo records its first case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo marks Brazil's first case in 2026. A 6-month-old girl, unvaccinated and resident of São Paulo, contracted measles after exposure linked to Bolivia, where an outbreak has been ongoing since 2025. The child traveled to Bolivia from 25 December 2025 to 25 January 2026; the case is considered imported. Laboratory confirmation occurred in early March 2026 by the São Paulo municipality after genomic sequencing, with the Ministry of Health noting the import origin. This is the first confirmed measles case in the State of São Paulo in 2026; São Paulo state had two imported cases in 2025. Nationwide, Brazil reported 38 confirmed cases in 2025 (Tocantins 25; Mato Grosso 6; Rio de Janeiro 2; São Paulo 2; Distrito Federal 1; Rio Grande do Sul 1; Maranhão 1). Bolivia has an ongoing outbreak near Brazil’s borders with Mato Grosso do Sul and Tocantins. Measles is highly contagious; vaccination is crucial; symptoms include fever, red rash, cough, conjunctivitis; complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, dehydration; transmission is airborne.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロが2026年の初症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ボリビアからの輸入麻疹症例であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。ブラジル国内での麻疹再発生の兆候であり、ワクチン未接種の乳幼児への感染など公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ボリビアで2025年から継続中の麻疹流行に関連した輸入症例。ブラジルは2025年に38例の確定例を報告しており、2026年の症例増加傾向が懸念される。ワクチン未接種の乳幼児が感染しており、肺炎や脳炎などの合併症リスクがある。国境地帯（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、トカンチンス州）での流行との関連性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Melonjak di Awal 2026, Pemerintah Percepat Imunisasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases surge at the start of 2026, government accelerates immunization.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surged at the start of 2026, with 45 outbreaks reported across 29 districts/cities in 11 provinces as of week 8. Week 7 recorded 9,947 suspected cases and 7,922 confirmed cases with 5 deaths; week 8 rose to 10,453 suspected and 8,372 confirmed cases, with 6 deaths. In response, the Ministry of Health accelerated immunization, targeting 102 districts/cities for outbreak response immunization aimed at children aged 9–59 months. The program concentrates on outbreak-affected areas through Outbreak Response Immunization and on high-risk regions via a Catch-Up Campaign to immunize those not yet reached. The surge signals ongoing measles transmission early in 2026, prompting intensified vaccination to curb spread across the affected provinces. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak response, catch-up campaign, measles, public health.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初頭の麻疹患者数の急増、政府がワクチン接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹の多県にわたる大規模集団発生（11州29地区で45件の集団感染、確診例8,372件、死亡6件）が報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的な懸念が想定される。
triage.notes: インドネシアの麻疹集団発生は2026年初頭における重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。複数州にわたる広地理的分布、死亡症例の存在、急速な症例増加（Week 7から Week 8で +506確診例）が特徴。政府による積極的な対応（アウトブレイク対応ワクチン接種、キャッチアップキャンペーン）が既に開始されている。WPRO地域における麻疹は制御可能な疾患であるが、本事例は免疫接種カバレッジの不十分さを示唆しており、地域内での流行のリスク、および国際的な感染リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Nova linhagem do vírus Oropouche é identificada no Sudeste - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New lineage of the Oropouche virus identified in Southeast Brazil - Urgent.
article.articleSummary: New reassortant lineage of Oropouche virus circulating in Southeast Brazil, with 55 confirmed infections in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais from December 2024 to May 2025. Researchers from Universidade Federal Fluminense analyzed 55 confirmed cases; genetic sequencing identifies a reassortant lineage, indicating genome segment reorganization and adaptation to the Southeast, suggesting potential longer-term establishment with variable circulation. Findings published January 7 in Open Forum Infectious Diseases. Clinically, most patients reported severe headaches and malaise (87%), along with fever, myalgia, and skin rashes. This expands the virus’s geographic range beyond its historic Amazon region association. No deaths reported in the study; authors warn of ongoing regional circulation and possible shifts in epidemiology.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南東部でオロポーシェウイルスの新しい系統が確認される
triage.triage_reason: オロポーシェウイルスの新規系統がブラジル南東部で確認され、従来のアマゾン地域から地理的範囲が拡大している。55例の確認患者、遺伝的変異の報告があり、異常性・重症度・流行ポテンシャルが懸念される。
triage.notes: オロポーシェウイルスはブニヤウイルス科に属し、蚊媒介性感染症。新規遺伝子系統（reassortant）の出現と南東部への地理的拡大が重要な懸念点。患者の87%が重度の頭痛・悪寒を報告、死亡はないが継続的な地域循環が警告されている。国際的拡大リスクおよび管理可能性の情報が不足しているため、継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de hepatite A aumentam em Ribeirão Preto, SP, e colocam Saúde em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Hepatitis A are rising in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, and health authorities are on alert.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A cases rise in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, prompting a health alert. From January through March 2026, the city recorded 203 Hepatitis A cases, compared with only 2 in the same period of 2025. Officials say the increase began in December and has persisted, described as a surge beyond what is expected but not exponential. Transmission occurs via contaminated water, food or objects, and through close contact or sharing utensils; sexual transmission with fecal-oral exposure is possible. No single contamination point has been identified; authorities investigate case-by-case and coordinate with healthcare networks to provide laboratory diagnostics. Symptoms typically begin with fatigue, fever and nausea, followed by gastrointestinal symptoms; darker urine and jaundice can appear in advanced stages. Vaccination against Hepatitis A is available through the SUS in all city vaccination sites and is advised for children and at-risk groups. Prevention emphasizes hygiene and vaccination; avoid alcohol during treatment.

triage.headline_ja: リベイラン・プレトのA型肝炎患者が増加、サンパウロ州で衛生当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎の集団発生で、短期間に著明な患者数増加（2025年同期2件→2026年同期203件）が記録され、異常・予想外の状況が確認されたため。IHR基準では異常性と重症度の懸念が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数の基準該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 2026年1月～3月に203件の報告は2025年同期比101倍の増加であり、12月から継続している持続的な流行。水・食物経由の感染が疑われ、感染源が特定されていない点が懸念される。予防接種が推奨されている。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクについては記事に明記されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave (SRAG) voltam a aumentar no país - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) on the rise again in the country - O Alto Acre.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases are rising across Brazil, per Fiocruz InfoGripe. In Epidemiological Week 8 (Feb 22–28), increases occurred in 23 states and the Federal District; Roraima, Tocantins, Espírito Santo and Rio Grande do Sul did not rise. Hospitalizations have grown, with a notable rise among children and adolescents—linked to the return to school. Parents are advised to keep symptomatic kids at home or, if needed, have them wear masks in class. Ten states report SRAG at alert/risk/high risk; 12 of 27 capitals show activity with a long-term growth trend. In 2026, over 14,300 SRAG cases were notified, with 35% lab-confirmed for a respiratory virus; rhinovirus is most detected, followed by influenza A and SARS-CoV-2. COVID-19 accounts for most deaths, then influenza A and rhinovirus. Incidence remains higher in young children, while mortality is highest among the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全土で急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）患者が再び増加中
triage.triage_reason: 複数の州にわたるCOVID-19とインフルエンザAの同時流行、入院患者の増加（特に小児・青年層）、複数州でのアラート/リスク発令により、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ブラジル全土23州および連邦直轄区での増加傾向、Fiocruzによる公式監視データの報告、学校再開に関連した小児の入院増加、複数病原体（SARS-CoV-2、インフルエンザA、ライノウイルス）の同時流行が特徴。死亡は高齢者で多いが、発症率は小児で高い。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор направил запрос в Таиланд из-за вспышки инфекции на Пхукете
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor sent a request to Thailand due to an outbreak of infection in Phuket.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor responded to media reports of a mass illness among Russian tourists in a Phuket hotel by sending formal data requests to Thailand’s Ministry of Health and to the Russian travel association ATOR, under a sanitary-epidemiological cooperation memorandum, to obtain official investigation results and a risk assessment of potential worsening of the outbreak. The agency’s press service said the situation is under control. Telegram channel Baza previously reported that 13 Russians were affected with gastroenteritis and conjunctivitis at the Thai resort, with tourists stating they drank tap water that was muddy and had a foul odor. Affected location is Phuket, Thailand; the implicated conditions are intestinal infection (gastroenteritis) and conjunctivitis. No official case counts beyond the reported 13 are confirmed in the article; the exchange underscores cross-border public health cooperation. Published date: 2026-03-15.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、プーケットの感染症流行のためタイへ要請を送付
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の感染症（Unknown Illness）によるロシア人観光客の集団発症が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、流行のしやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、確認されている症例数が限定的（13人）で、公式確認が不十分なため、情報確認待ちの段階。
triage.notes: 疾患が『Unknown Illness』と分類されており、具体的な病原体特定が未了。13名のロシア人観光客による胃腸炎および結膜炎の集団発症が報告されているが、公式な症例確認数が限定的。水質問題（濁水、異臭）との関連が指摘されている。ロシアの衛生疫学庁（Rospotrebnadzor）がタイ保健省に正式な調査結果と追加情報を要請している点から、国家レベルでの関心が確認される。IHR基準では2つ未満の該当のため PICKUP に至らないが、WPRO基準で複数該当し、政府間の対応が既に開始されているため WATCH として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Inverno amazônico eleva mortes por SRAG no Acre; estado já registra 16 óbitos em 2026 - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonian winter increases SARS deaths in Acre; the state already records 16 deaths in 2026 - O Alto Acre
article.articleSummary: In Acre, Brazil, 16 deaths from severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) were reported in the first weeks of 2026, signaling a worrisome “Amazonian winter.” Most fatalities had comorbidities or were in high-risk groups (elderly, young children). The surge coincides with heavy rains that favor circulation of respiratory viruses, notably Influenza A and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). In February, Feijó municipality recorded two SARI deaths—a 59-year-old woman and a 6-year-old Indigenous child—linked to influenza A and rhinovirus. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes Acre among Northern states with SARI at elevated risk; nationally, rhinovirus accounts for 36.5% of positives, followed by SARS-CoV-2 20.4% and Influenza A 18.9%. Authorities emphasize continuous monitoring and clinical readiness; pregnant women vaccination is highlighted as a strategy to protect newborns against RSV. The situation remains under health surveillance as the season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの冬がアクレ州のSARI死亡を増加させる。州は2026年に16人の死亡を既に記録している - オ・アルト・アクレ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州でSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）による死亡が16件報告されており、重症度が高く異常な季節パターンを示している。Influenza AおよびRSV感染が確認されており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: アクレ州は北部地域の中でも高リスク地域としてFiocruzのInfoGripeで指摘されている。季節的な気象パターン（アマゾンの冬と大雨）が呼吸器ウイルスの流行を促進している。妊婦のRSV対策ワクチン接種が戦略として強調されている。国家的な監視体制が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Investigadores advierten sobre hongo que pasa de gatos a personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers warn about a fungus that passes from cats to humans
article.articleSummary: First identified in Uruguay, Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus causing sporotrichosis, now poses a cat-to-human transmission risk with alerts for potential epidemics. The finding arose from a 2025 intrafamilial outbreak affecting people and their pets; initial link to a Brazilian street cat was later disproven as cases appeared in other areas. Dr. Elisa Cabeza notes the discovery confirms fungal circulation in Uruguay and supports strengthened surveillance, especially for vulnerable populations such as children under two and older adults. Sporotrichosis transmits from infected cats to humans when the fungus enters the skin via scratches, bites, or contact with wounds or secretions. Symptoms typically appear days to weeks after exposure: a small skin lesion at the injury site, followed by nodules along lymphatic pathways, with inflammation or redness. If diagnosed early, antifungal treatment is effective; veterinarians advise owners to inspect cats’ muzzles and ears for wounds or discharge.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが猫から人間に感染するキノコについて警告
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスの猫-ヒト感染リスク、ウルグアイでの新規発見、複数国での流行の可能性が示唆されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数該当を満たす。
triage.notes: Sporothrix brasiliensisはウルグアイで初めて同定された病原体であり、2025年の家族内集団発生から確認されている。ブラジルとウルグアイの両国で報告があり、国際的拡大の懸念がある。脆弱性人口（2歳未満の小児と高齢者）への影響が指摘されており、監視強化の必要性が明記されている。猫のヒト感染リスク、複数の伝播経路（引っ搔き、咬傷、開放創との接触）、および効果的な治療法の存在（早期診断時）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cómo es el hongo que gatos pueden transmitir a humanos?; especialistas activan alertas en Sudamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the fungus that cats can transmit to humans? Specialists issue alerts in South America.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a fungal infection primarily affecting the skin and subcutaneous tissue, is spreading from cats in South America. In late February, the Instituto de Higiene issued a population warning as surveillance in the Southern Cone intensified; Argentina also reports rising cases. The World Health Organization notes this Sporothrix fungus causes zoonotic infections transmitted via cats, with more than 11,000 human cases reported in the affected areas of South America over the past decade, mainly in Brazil. Transmission can also occur from other mammals or through contaminated materials or vegetation. Most infections are cutaneous, but rare cases can involve meningitis, arthritis, or respiratory infections. The alerts reflect regional monitoring changes and cross-border risk, with outbreaks linked to wood, mining materials, or flood-affected environments.

triage.headline_ja: 猫がヒトに感染させる可能性のあるカビとは？専門家が南米でアラートを発動
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは南米（ブラジル、アルゼンチン）で過去10年間に11,000人以上の患者報告があり、異常な拡大傾向を示している。動物媒介性感染症で国境を越えたリスク、複数国での同時増加、環境因子との関連が確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当。
triage.notes: 過去10年間に南米地域で11,000人以上の患者が報告されており、既に相当規模の流行状況。ブラジル、アルゼンチンで同時に増加傾向。動物（特に猫）からのヒト感染、環境媒介（汚染材料、植生）による伝播、洪水などの自然災害との関連も指摘されている。皮膚病変が主体だが髄膜炎など重症例の可能性もあり。南米全域での監視強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba intensifica combate à dengue com nebulização veicular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba intensifies the fight against dengue with vehicular fogging.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, launches a new phase of dengue vector control focused on Aedes aegypti, which transmits dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Starting Monday, March 16, through Wednesday, March 18, operations run from 6:30 PM in the neighborhoods of São Vicente, Novo Paraíso, Paraíso, and Jardim Brasil. A vehicle-mounted fogging system (Nebulização Acoplada a Veículo, NAV) disperses insecticide to target adult mosquitoes in street and residential areas. The initiative follows intensified house-to-house visits by municipal health agents and the removal of potential breeding containers, with reinforced resident guidance on preventive measures. The effort is conducted with the support of the Coordinadoria de Controle de Doenças, under the Secretaria de Estado da Saúde. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: Folha da Região: アラçアトゥーバが車両噴霧でデング熱との戦いを強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア、ジカの複合感染症が複数地域で報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、症例数、確認方法、重症度が記事に記載されていないため、情報不足の状態で判定。
triage.notes: 記事は対策実施（車両噴霧、容器の除去）についての報告であり、具体的な症例数、重症度、確認されたケースの詳細が記載されていない。複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）が関連しており、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク（蚊媒介）と長期曝露のリスクは存在する。ブラジル内での複合感染症爆発の可能性を示唆するが、現段階では詳細な疫学情報なしにシグナルとして確定できないため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupa expansión de fiebre amarilla fuera de la Amazonía, advierte la OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of the expansion of yellow fever outside the Amazon.
article.articleSummary: As of March 15, 2026, PAHO warns of expanded yellow fever transmission across South America, including regions outside the Amazon Basin. Since September 2024, transmissions have appeared in areas previously unreported. In 2025, 346 confirmed yellow fever cases and 143 deaths occurred across seven South American countries. In the first seven weeks of 2026, 34 human cases and 15 deaths were recorded in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, and Venezuela. PAHO urges member states to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, intensify vaccination campaigns for at-risk populations, and reinforce preventive measures for travelers to areas where yellow fever vaccination is recommended. The notice highlights a shifting epidemiology requiring sustained vaccination coverage and vigilance to curb further spread. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが警告：アマゾン以外での黄熱病拡大に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生影響（2025年に346確認例、143死亡）、異常な地理的拡大（従来の報告地域外への伝播）、複数国への国際的拡大が確認される。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、PAHOによる公式警告により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 黄熱病は従来アマゾン盆地に限定されていたが、2024年9月以降、地理的分布が拡大。2025年の死亡率は約41%（143/346）と高く、2026年も継続。ペルー、ブラジル、ボリビア、ベネズエラ、コロンビアの5ヶ国に拡大。PAHOによる公式警告と予防接種キャンペーン強化要求により、地域的・国際的対応の必要性が明確である。

article.articleHeadline: Over 15,900 Pet Cat Bite Cases Reported at SMHS in a Year - Kashmir Observer
article.articleSummary: Over one year (March 2025–March 2026), Shri Maharaja Hari Singh (SMHS) Hospital’s Anti-Rabies Clinic in Srinagar logged more than 15,900 pet cat bite cases from across Srinagar and other districts of the Kashmir Valley. The figure signals a steady demand for anti-rabies vaccination and post-bite care after domesticated cat bites or scratches. Medical staff note many patients seek care after seemingly minor injuries, but timely treatment is essential to prevent infections and rabies, which remains fatal once symptoms appear. Health guidance emphasizes washing wounds with soap and water immediately and seeking medical attention for post-exposure prophylaxis. Officials urge regular vaccination of pets and basic precautions in handling animals at home. The Anti-Rabies Clinic continues to vaccinate and treat hundreds of patients weekly, with cases from both urban and rural areas of the Kashmir Valley.

triage.headline_ja: SMHS病院で1年間に15,900件以上のペット猫咬傷事例を報告 - カシミール・オブザーバー
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病関連の動物咬傷事例の高い報告数（年間15,900件）は公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆するが、既知の流行症でありスリナガル地域の限定的な報告であるため、現時点では情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の致死的疾患で、特に動物咬傷患者の治療ニーズが継続的に存在している（週単位での数百人患者）。しかし記事は地域別の流行状況の急変を示唆しておらず、既存の医療体制で対応中と考えられる。スリナガル地域限定の報告であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。続報で患者数の増加傾向、死亡事例、あるいは新たな地域への拡大を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hongo que se transmite de gatos a humanos alerta a especialistas: así se contagia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fungus transmitted from cats to humans warns experts: this is how it spreads.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus affecting cats, is causing a cutaneous esporotricosis outbreak in southern Uruguay, around Maldonado and Rocha. Originating in Brazil, authorities warned in late February about the spread, with Argentina also reporting rising cases, signaling a Southern Cone shift in surveillance. The fungus thrives in tropical/subtropical climates and can be transmitted to humans via contact with infected felines, leading to esporotricosis that penetrates the skin and subcutaneous tissue; rare complications include meningitis, arthritis, or respiratory infections. In affected South American regions, Brazil has documented more than 11,000 human cases in the past decade. Diagnosis uses microscopy, histopathology, or culture, and treatment is straightforward and effective. Primary symptoms after feline contact are skin eruptions or red patches. Transmission can also occur from other mammals or contaminated materials/vegetation, with outbreaks worldwide linked to wood, mining materials, or floods.

triage.headline_ja: ネコからヒトに感染するキノコが専門家に警告を発しています：こうして感染します
triage.triage_reason: 南米（ウルグアイ、ブラジル、アルゼンチン）における動物由来感染症（スポロトリコーシス）の多国間での同時発生。ブラジルで過去10年間に11,000例以上の人間症例が記録されており、南米広域での流行拡大傾向が見られる。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは既知の真菌感染症だが、本事象は南米における多国間での同時流行拡大（ウルグアイ新規検出、アルゼンチン症例増加、ブラジル急増）という異常な疫学パターンを示している。動物由来感染症（zoonotic）で、ネコとの直接接触を通じた人獣共通感染リスクが高い。熱帯・亜熱帯気候での流行しやすさと、南米での大規模ヒト感染歴（ブラジル11,000例以上）から公衆衛生上の重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Campak-Rubella Menyebar di Kabupaten Cirebon, 75 Kasus Terdeteksi di 60 Puskesmas, Losari Tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles-Rubella Spreading in Cirebon Regency, 75 Cases Detected in 60 Community Health Centers, Losari Highest.
article.articleSummary: Between 2025 and early 2026, measles and rubella circulated in Cirebon Regency, Indonesia. Health authorities recorded 75 confirmed cases in 60 puskesmas during 2025—69 measles and 6 rubella—across nearly all subdistricts, with Losari Puskesmas reporting the highest case load. Of 521 suspected samples tested, 75 were confirmed. In early 2026, up to week 8, 148 suspected cases yielded 7 confirmed infections: 6 measles and 1 rubella. Measles predominated, with Astanajapura Puskesmas reporting two confirmed in early 2026; other confirmations were in Cibogo, Kamarang, Karangsari, and Pamengkang; rubella was detected in Kepuh. The reports were from Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Cirebon, as of March 15, 2026 (current date).

triage.headline_ja: シレボン県ではしか・風疹が蔓延、60の保健センターで75例が検出、ロサリが最多
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（予想外の複数地域での同時流行）、国際拡大リスク（発展途上国での予防接種率低下リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行易易性・管理可能性で複数該当。複数州にまたがる確認症例75例（2025年）+ 7例（2026年初）の継続流行を示す。
triage.notes: インドネシア・シレボン県における麻疹・風疹の同時流行。2025年確認75例（麻疹69例、風疹6例）、2026年初週～8週で確認7例（麻疹6例、風疹1例）。60の保健センター（puskesmas）にまたがり、複数の州（ジャワ・バラット州、バンテン州、ジャカルタ州、ヨグヤカルタ州）を含む広域流行。麻疹は予防接種で防止可能な疾患であり、インドネシアのような発展途上国での流行は予防接種カバレッジの課題を示唆。継続的な感染確認と地理的拡大が認められるため、シグナルとしてピックアップし、フルRRAを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo: Cholera Epidemic 2026 - DREF Operation (MDRCD049)
article.articleSummary: Cholera epidemic ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of EW7_2026 with 1,094 suspected cases and 26 deaths (case fatality rate ~1%). Of the 26 deaths, 6 occurred in health facilities and 20 in the community, signaling access-to-care delays. By EW7_2026, 13 provinces and 84 health zones have reported at least one suspected case. The most affected provinces are Kinshasa, South Kivu, Tanganyika, Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami, North Kivu, and Lualaba; additional provinces with cases/deaths include Mai-Ndombe, Sankuru, Tshopo, Équateur, Maniema, and Kongo Central. The distribution shows a multi-focal epidemic with major hotspots in the eastern and southeastern regions and in Kinshasa. The outbreak shows an increasing trend in reporting compared with earlier weeks and with 2024–2025, signaling higher disease severity and treatment access challenges. This is linked to the DREF operation MDRCD049.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：2026年コレラ流行 - DREF活動（MDRCD049）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のコレラ流行（1,094疑い例、26死亡）が13州84保健地域に拡大し、多焦点流行を示している。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的支援（DREF活動）が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 複数州への急速な拡大、保健施設外での死亡が多い（20/26）ことが医療アクセスの課題を示唆。2024-2025年比での症例増加傾向が報告されている。DREF（赤十字・赤新月社の緊急救援基金）の活動化により国際支援が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Booster Vaksin pada Orang Tua Bisa Lindungi Bayi dari Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine booster for parents can protect infants from measles.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, rising measles cases in Indonesia prompt discussion on adult vaccination. Pediatrician and IDAI chair Dr. Piprim Basarah Yanuarso states the measles vaccine remains effective in adults and can be crucial for protecting infants not yet eligible for immunization. A booster for parents helps shield babies in households with immune adults, especially for infants 2–3 months old. If adult immunization is incomplete, an MR booster is advised. Indonesia’s national program focuses on children aged 9 months to about 15 years due to vaccine stock, with measles vaccination commonly given at 9 months and MR boosters at 2 and 5 years. IDAI also supports MMR at 15 months and again at 5 years. Adults may receive boosters to refresh immune memory; MMR doses can be offered around pregnancy or before marriage, two doses in such scenarios to strengthen protection against measles, mumps, and rubella.

triage.headline_ja: 親のワクチンブースターは麻疹から乳幼児を保護できる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹患者数の増加が報告されており、予防接種戦略の議論が進行中。現時点では具体的な患者数、死亡例、地理的拡大範囲などの詳細情報が不足しているため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹患者数増加の事実を述べているが、具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡例などの量的データが記載されていない。IDAI（インドネシア小児科医師会）が公式声明を出していることから、地域の公式関心が確認される。麻疹は高い伝播性を持ち、乳幼児への危険性が懸念される。より詳細な流行規模情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alta da dengue faz busca por telas disparar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue surge drives demand for screens.
article.articleSummary: Dengue surge in Brazil during the rainy season drives demand for window barriers to curb Aedes aegypti transmission. In the first months of the year, rising dengue case numbers push families to install insect screens to keep mosquitoes out of homes. However, this coverage can create a dangerous false sense of security for fall protection in apartments. Preventing tragedies requires exterior structural nets paired with interior screens, not DIY installations. Two distinct materials: fiberglass-based mosquito nets (PVC or lightweight nylon) designed to block insects; and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) safety nets that form 5x5 cm meshes for fall protection. The HDPE nets are anchored directly to masonry with galvanized or stainless-steel hooks and anchors and can withstand up to 500 kg per square meter. Installation should be layered: exterior structural net installed first by specialists, then interior mosquito net; ensure independent tensioning and provide material guarantees.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の急増がスクリーン（網戸）の検索需要を急騰させている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱症例増加は公衆衛生への関心を反映しているが、記事は主に防虫対策製品の需要についての経済・建設関連の話題であり、疾病の規模、重症度、国際拡大リスク等の感染症危機管理に関する具体的情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジルの雨期におけるデング熱症例増加は周知の季節的パターンであり、異常事象ではない。記事は疾病の医学的詳細（症例数、死亡数、重症度分布）や地域範囲の具体的情報を欠いており、公開情報のみに基づくシグナル判定には不十分。続報で症例数、死亡数、地域拡大状況の具体情報が提供された場合はPICKUP再評価の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta Epidemiológica: Fiebre amarilla en la Región de las Américas - 13 de marzo del 2026 - Brazil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Alert: Yellow Fever in the Region of the Americas - March 13, 2026 - Brazil
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever alert for the Americas issued March 13, 2026, with Brazil highlighted as affected. Since September 2024, yellow fever cases have been reported in areas with no historical transmission, including areas outside the Amazon region. The Pan American Health Organization and World Health Organization (OPS/OMS) urge member states to strengthen surveillance, intensify vaccination campaigns for at‑risk populations, and ensure travelers to areas with reported cases are informed and protected against yellow fever. The alert also emphasizes enhanced clinical management, focusing on early detection and timely treatment of severe disease. Authorities should maintain vaccine stockpiles aligned with national availability to guarantee a rapid response to potential outbreaks. The message underscores international coordination to prevent spread and safeguard travelers and residents in the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学的警報：2026年3月13日のアメリカ地域における黄熱病 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の地理的拡大（アマゾン地域外への拡大、カナリア諸島への言及）、複数国への国際的リスク、WHOおよびPAHOによる公式警報発出、ヒト-ベクトル感染経路の存在により、IHR基準2つ以上およびWPRO基準複数に該当。
triage.notes: 2024年9月以降、黄熱病の歴史的伝播地域外での新規症例報告が複数地域で確認されている。スペイン領カナリア諸島の言及は、アフリカ大陸への近接性を考慮すると、ユーラシア地域への拡大リスクを示唆。WHOおよびPAHOによる公式警報、ワクチン接種キャンペーン強化の呼びかけ、および国際調整の強調は、この事象が既に高いレベルの地域および国際的関心を集めていることを示す。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Republic of Congo Humanitarian Flash Update No. 3 (Cholera Outbreak Response), 13 March 2026 - Congo
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Republic of Congo persists with 997 cumulative cases and an 8.3% CFR. July 2025 outbreak progressed to end-2025 with 826 suspected cases and 67 deaths (CFR 8%). District breakdown: Mbamou Island 336/12 (3.6%), Mossaka 432/54 (12.5%), Gamboma 59, Talangaï 10/1. After nine weeks without cases, resurgence occurred in Mbamou Island (Brazzaville) and Congo-Oubangui in February 2026. By March 11, 196 suspected cases since Feb 13, mainly Mossaka and Mbamou Island; laboratory confirmation: Liranga District 4, Mbamou Island 3; eight deaths. A third hotspot emerged in Impfondo (Likouala) with 14 alerts and five deaths in early March. CFR 8.3% exceeds the regional 2.2% average. Affected districts sit along a transboundary river corridor with DRC (Liranga, Mossaka-Lokolela, Impfondo, Mbamou Island, Makotimpoko). Risk factors include unsafe drinking water, open defecation, poor hygiene, and cross-river food exchanges; ongoing Mpox and rising influenza complicate response; UNICEF/WHO support strengthens risk communication and WASH interventions.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフ コンゴ共和国人道支援フラッシュ更新 第3号（コレラ流行対応）、2026年3月13日 - コンゴ
triage.triage_reason: コレラの複数地域での持続的な流行（997累積症例、CFR 8.3%）、国境を越えた拡大リスク、Mpoxとインフルエンザの並行流行により、IHR基準3項目該当およびWPRO基準5項目すべて該当。国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ共和国とDRC間の国境地域における複数の流行ホットスポット（Mossaka、Mbamou Island、Impfondo）が同時活動中。9週間の沈静化後の2月下旬からの再発生は異常。CFR 8.3%は地域平均の3.7倍。並行するMpoxおよびインフルエンザ流行により対応能力が圧迫されており、WASH環境改善と越境監視の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: OPS alerta sobre la transmisión sostenida de la fiebre amarilla en Sudamérica | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of sustained transmission of yellow fever in South America | Noticias RCN
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever continues in South America with sustained transmission reported by PAHO as of March 2026, expanding beyond traditional foci. The viral hemorrhagic disease is endemic in tropical Africa, Central America, and South America. Since September 2024, cases have appeared in areas previously unrecorded, including outside the Amazon. In 2025, PAHO recorded 346 confirmed cases and 143 deaths across seven countries: Bolivia (8/2), Brazil (120/48), Colombia (125/46), Ecuador (11/8), Peru (49/19), Venezuela (32/19), and Guyana (numbers not provided). In the first seven weeks of 2026, 34 cases and 15 deaths were reported in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, and Venezuela. Transmission near urban centers raises risk of spread via Aedes aegypti. PAHO urges enhanced surveillance, expanded vaccination in at-risk populations, traveler advisories, rapid clinical management, and maintained vaccine stocks; 2025 CFR was 41%.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、南米での黄熱病の持続的な伝播について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では深刻な影響（高い致死率41%、多数の死亡）と異常性（従来の流行地域外での発生拡大）に該当。WPRO基準では重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数項目に該当し、複数国での国際的な拡大が示唆されている。
triage.notes: 2025年の致死率41%と極めて高い。2024年9月以降、アマゾン外の非伝統的流行地での症例報告が増加している。都市中心部近郊での伝播はネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）による拡大リスクを示唆し、地域内外への拡大可能性が高い。7カ国での流行に対してPAHOが強い警告を発しており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemiological Alert: Yellow fever in the Americas Region - 13 March 2026 - Brazil
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in the Americas—PAHO/WHO urges intensified surveillance, vaccination of at-risk populations, traveler information, and strengthened clinical management with reserve vaccine stockpiles for rapid response (as of 16 March 2026). For 2025 EW1–EW53, 346 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported across seven countries, with 143 deaths (CFR 41%). Breakdowns: Bolivia 8/2; Brazil 120/48; Colombia 125/46; Ecuador 11/8; Guyana 1 death; Peru 49/19; Venezuela 32/19. In 2026 EW1–EW7, 34 confirmed cases across four countries were reported, including 15 deaths (CFR 44%): Bolivia 1 death; Colombia 25/13; Peru 2; Venezuela 6/1. The 2025 total is high relative to recent years but mirrors historic peaks (e.g., 1966, 1998, 2003). Public health measures, vaccine availability, and traveler protection are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学警報：2026年3月13日 アメリカ地域における黄熱 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱がアメリカ大陸の複数国（ボリビア、ブラジル、コロンビア、エクアドル、ガイアナ、ペルー、ベネズエラ）で発生し、2025年には346確定症例・143死亡（CFR 41%）、2026年も34症例・15死亡が報告されている。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生事象であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: PAHO/WHOから疫学警報が発出されており、ワクチン備蓄の活用と国際的な対応強化が求められている。スペイン（カナリア諸島）の記載は渡航者からの輸入症例の可能性を示唆。黄熱は国際保健規則(IHR 2005)における通報対象疾患であり、複数国での同時流行は重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: พบเคสในไทย?! ติดไวรัสเพราะ "เห็บกัด" ตัวเดียว สมองอักเสบ-อวัยวะล้มเหลว : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case found in Thailand?! Infected by a virus from a single tick bite—encephalitis and organ failure: Check the news for accuracy.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports a confirmed case of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) caused by the tick-borne virus SFTSV. Transmission occurs via tick bites or exposure to ticks or infected animals/pets. Infected individuals typically present with high fever, thrombocytopenia (low platelets), and elevated liver enzymes; severe complications can include multi-organ failure or meningitis/encephalitis and may be fatal. Not all tick exposures result in severe disease; estimated morbidity and mortality range from 5% to 28%. The article warns about silent risk from tick bites and urges vigilance for potential central nervous system involvement. The confirmed case in Thailand underscores the ongoing risk of tick-borne viral infections in the country as of 2026-03-16.

triage.headline_ja: タイで発見された事例?! 単一のダニ刺傷からウイルスに感染—脳炎と臓器不全：ニュースを正確にチェック
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるSFTS確定症例の報告であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、ダニ媒介感染症の地域における新規確認はシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）はダニ媒介ウイルスであり、死亡率5-28%と高い。タイにおける確定症例報告は東南アジア地域における重要なシグナルである。記事は「脳炎」「臓器不全」などの重篤な合併症についても言及しており、中枢神経系への関与可能性が強調されている。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quan với viêm họng, nữ sinh nguy kịch vì siêu vi khuẩn tấn công tim và não
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neglecting a sore throat leaves a female student in critical condition as a superbug attacks her heart and brain.
article.articleSummary: Sixteen-year-old female student from Son La, Vietnam, developed septicemia due to Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) with acute infectious endocarditis, pneumonia, and multiple brain injuries. Initially treated for pharyngitis, she had persistent high fever (39–40°C), fatigue, and a non-dermal rash including Janeway lesions on palms and soles. Blood cultures confirmed MRSA. Echocardiography showed vegetations on the mitral valve with severe regurgitation; two eccentric regurgitant jets measured 4 mm and 5 mm. Brain imaging revealed scattered ischemic strokes in both hemispheres and cerebellar hemorrhage with right-sided weakness; pneumonia also diagnosed. History of mitral valve regurgitation since June 2025 likely predisposed to endocarditis. After urgent multidisciplinary review, she received targeted MRSA antibiotics; within three days, CRP dropped from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L, fever resolved, and neurological function improved, with follow-up imaging showing reduced vegetations and no new brain lesions. No skin lesions observed, suggesting mucosal entry.

triage.headline_ja: 咽頭炎を軽視した女子生徒が危篤状態に：耐性菌が心臓と脳を侵襲
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重症感染性心内膜炎の個別症例報告。国内での散発事例と判断されるが、MRSA蔓延状況、感染源の特定、医療施設内の流行の有無など重要な疫学情報が不足。続報で複数症例発生の有無を確認すべき。
triage.notes: ベトナムの地元メディア(Tien Phong)による報道。16歳の患者は個別症例であり、院内感染・集団発生の証拠なし。記事焦点は医療遅延による合併症の警告。MRSA自体はWPRO地域で既知の脅威。流行規模、感染源（医療施設か市中か）、他症例の有無が不明のため、現時点ではWATCHとする。複数症例発生報告で判定見直しの可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm họng tưởng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi bị 'siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công não tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mild sore throat, 16-year-old female student struck by a 'superbug' attacking the brain and heart.
article.articleSummary: A 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam, with initial symptoms of sore throat and high fever progressed to septicemic illness, presenting Janeway lesions on palms/soles. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bacteremia. Diagnosed with acute infectious endocarditis on a pre-existing mitral valve regurgitation (detected June 2025). Echocardiography showed mitral valve vegetations with severe regurgitation (murmur 3/6) and two eccentric leaks (4 mm and 5 mm). MRSA also caused pneumonia. Brain imaging revealed scattered bilateral cerebral infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhage, causing ataxia and right upper-limb weakness (3/5). No skin infection was noted; authors suggest entry via minor oropharyngeal mucosal injuries. After multidisciplinary care and MRSA-targeted antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L in 3 days; fever resolved; patient regained consciousness, right-arm weakness and ataxia improved; follow-up imaging showed reduced vegetations and resolved brain lesions. Emphasizes vigilance for persistent fever and subtle signs indicating endocarditis.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い喉の炎症と思ったら、16歳の女子学生が「耐性菌」に脳と心臓を攻撃される
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による感染性心内膜炎と脳梗塞の重症例であり、個別症例の臨床的価値は高い。しかし、単一症例報告であり、集団発生の証拠がなく、ベトナムでのMRSA感染症は既知の疾患であるため、新規シグナルとしてのPICKUP基準には未達。情報充実度は高いが、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性が明確ではない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の重症事例。MRSA自体は既知病原体であり、新興感染症ではない。ベトナムでの患者管理は成功しており、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。集団発生の兆候なし。臨床的に興味深い個別症例だが、感染症危機管理シグナルとしてのPICKUP基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến khó đoán, nhiều ca chuyển nặng nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever progresses unpredictably, many cases quickly become severe.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever continues to threaten public health as cases rise and progression is unpredictable. In 2025 Vietnam reported more than 181,000 dengue cases and 43 deaths. Globally, dengue infects about 390 million annually, with roughly 500,000 hospitalizations and over 40,000 deaths. Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Early symptoms: sudden high fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, and rash; without close monitoring, patients can quickly develop shock, severe bleeding, ARDS, liver and kidney failure, or neurologic damage. Even after critical illness, long-term sequelae such as hair loss, cognitive impairment, and insomnia may persist. NS1 testing can be negative early; follow-up laboratory tests and clinical observation are essential. WHO-recommended vaccines, approved in more than 40 countries, should be part of a comprehensive strategy, alongside vector control (mosquito elimination, larval source reduction, bed nets). Vaccination enhances protection but does not replace preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の進行は予測困難で、多くの症例が急速に重症化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのディエンビエン省で予測不可能な進行と急速な重症化を特徴とするデング熱の拡大が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と管理可能性で該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムは2025年に181,000件以上のデング患者と43死亡を報告。全球的には年390万人が感染し、約500,000入院、40,000死亡超。「予測困難な進行」と「急速な重症化」が強調されており、臨床的な懸念が高い。ディエンビエン省は北西部の辺境地域であり、ベクター管理と医療資源の課題が想定される。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito menace, poor sanitation raise dengue fears in Madurai city
article.articleSummary: As of 16 March 2026, dengue concerns rise in Madurai city, India, with residents of Sadasiva Nagar, Ward 37, reporting fever cases amid deteriorating sanitation and stagnant water. Maraimalai Adigal Street resident Syed Basha claims at least three dengue cases. Corporation officials say only one dengue case has been laboratory-confirmed to date and that preventive measures are being deployed. The mosquito problem is attributed to poor sanitation, stagnant water, and issues with the newly installed underground drainage (UGD) system, including sewage overflow despite limited household connections. The report underscores dengue risk in Madurai and calls for prompt sanitation improvements and vector-control efforts to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の問題と不衛生な環境がマドゥライ市のデング熱への懸念を高める

article.articleHeadline: Siêu vi khuẩn tấn công não và tim nữ sinh 16 tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superbugs Attack the Brain and Heart of a 16-Year-Old Female Student.
article.articleSummary: MRSA septicemia with acute infectious endocarditis and multifocal cerebral infarction with intracerebral hemorrhage in a 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam. After five days of antibiotics for presumed pharyngitis, persistent high fever (39–40°C), tachycardia, hypotension, and Janeway lesions on hands/feet prompted transfer to the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases. Blood cultures confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Echocardiography revealed severe mitral valve regurgitation with vegetations and two eccentric jets (4 mm and 5 mm). Neuroimaging showed scattered cerebral infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhage, causing ataxia and right-arm weakness (3/5). Pneumonia was a concurrent complication. History includes known mitral valve prolapse with regurgitation diagnosed in June 2025. After aggressive MRSA-directed antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L within 3 days; fever resolved, neurological function improved, and brain MRI showed no residual lesions. Highlights need for early echocardiography in prolonged fever and Janeway lesions as markers of endocarditis.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバグが16歳の女子学生の脳と心臓を襲う
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重症感染症（心内膜炎、脳梗塞、脳出血）の個別症例報告であり、重症度は高い。しかし、単一症例の臨床レポート性質が強く、現在のアウトブレイク・流行の兆候は記事から不明。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度基準に該当するが、国際的拡大リスク、流行易感染性、長期曝露の可能性は記事から判断不可のため、続報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 本レポートは16歳患者の個別症例報告であり、クラスターや流行の証拠はない。MRSA自体は既知の耐性菌だが、複数臓器侵襲（心内膜炎+脳梗塞+脳出血）の同時発症は臨床的に注目される。ベトナムでのMRSA感染症の疫学的傾向、同地域での他の類似症例の有無、院内感染との関連性などについて続報が必要。現時点ではアウトブレイク兆候なしと判断するが、臨床的重症度の高さから経過観察継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Nova cepa do vírus da Mpox recombinante preocupa OMS e testes mostram que antiviral mais usado não é eficaz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New recombinant Mpox virus strain concerns WHO, and tests show that the most commonly used antiviral is not effective.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) faces a new recombinant strain, combining elements of clades Ib (Central Africa) and IIb (global 2022 outbreak). WHO notes conventional PCR cannot identify the recombinant; full-genome sequencing is required. Two travel-associated confirmed cases—UK and India—imply broader spread across at least four countries in three WHO regions. Clinically, tecovirimat (the main orthopox antiviral) did not improve outcomes in the STOMP randomized trial (NEJM 2026) for clade II mpox: 83% lesion resolution with treatment vs 84% with placebo; pain reduction and viral clearance were similar. PALM007 in DR Congo found similar results for clade I. Vulnerable groups (immunocompromised, pregnant individuals, children) were underrepresented. Africa: 26 countries reported >139,000 suspected cases and ~1,788 deaths (Jan 2024–May 2025). Brazil: clade Ib confirmed in São Paulo, March 2025, changing risk profile. Recommendations: enhance genomic surveillance, revise clinical protocols, prioritize vaccination now for at-risk groups, and ensure monitoring for imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい組み換え型Mpoxウイルス株がWHOを懸念させ、最も一般的に使用されている抗ウイルス薬が有効でないことがテストで示された
triage.triage_reason: Mpox組み換え型（Clade Ib/IIbハイブリッド）の出現、複数の医療上の懸念（既存治療薬の無効性）、少なくとも3地域4ヶ国での確認例、アフリカでの大規模流行（139,000疑い例、1,788死亡）により、IHR基準および WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 重大なポイント：(1) 新しい組み換え型Mpoxの出現で、既存PCR診断では検出不可、フルゲノム解析が必須。(2) tecovirimat（テコビリマット）がClade II Mpoxで有効でないことが無作為化試験（NEJM 2026）で証明される危機的事態。(3) アフリカ26ヶ国での大規模流行継続、ブラジルSão Paulo州でClade Ib確認（2025年3月）。(4) 複数WHO地域での旅行関連症例（英国、インド）により国際的拡大が現実化。(5) 免疫不全者、妊娠者、小児などの脆弱集団が治療試験で過少代表。フルRRAおよび緊急対応の開始が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: FMD vaccination drive for cattle in AP from today under National Animal Disease Control Programme
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-M mouth Disease vaccination drive underway in Andhra Pradesh from March 16 to April 29, 2026, under the National Animal Disease Control Programme. Free vaccines will be administered to cattle and buffaloes; staff will visit livestock owners’ homes. A total of 83.69 lakh doses have been distributed to districts to cover animals in two phases: main round March 16–April 14, followed by a booster and remaining coverage April 15–29. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle and buffaloes, particularly cross-bred animals with weaker immunity, causing reduced milk production, weakness, diminished working capacity, and calf deaths, with heavy economic losses. Symptoms include high fever, blistering in the mouth and hooves, and drooling; recovery may take up to six months. Vaccination is presented as the only effective preventive measure; farmers urged to participate.

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah Aceh rencanakan pembangunan selter tangani kasus Rabies - ANTARA News Aceh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Aceh government plans to build shelters to handle rabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Rabies control efforts in Aceh involve building shelters for stray dogs to curb rabies after cases detected in Bireuen district. The plan, announced by Safridhal, Head of Aceh Province Department of Animal Husbandry, envisions capturing stray dogs and relocating them to regions where households keep dogs, such as Medan, North Sumatra. Authorities emphasize a humane, systematic approach; elimination of stray dogs is no longer permitted. As an initial step, the animal health team has conducted field vaccination of pets in Bireuen to interrupt animal-to-human transmission. Aceh's key strategies include active vaccination campaigns, public education on rabies risks and proper animal care, ongoing outreach, and prioritization of a dedicated budget for broader rabies vaccination. The government continues to promote vaccination efforts in Bireuen.

triage.headline_ja: アチェ州政府が狂犬病対策のための犬舎建設を計画
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はヒト・動物共通感染症で重症度が高いが、本記事は既知の疾患への対策・予防活動の報道であり、新規感染患者数の急増や流行の兆候は報告されていない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%で重篤な疾患（severity: Yes）。野犬による継続的な露出リスク（prolonged_exposure: Yes）とヒト-動物間の感染性（epidemic_prone: Yes）が存在。一方、報告は州政府による対策計画の発表であり、新規患者の急増や流行の拡大を示す具体的根拠が記事に含まれていない（unusual_unexpected: 不明）。Bireuen地区での検出との記述はあるが、患者数や流行規模は不明。当初段階の対応が既に進行中（vaccination campaign）であり、管理可能性は比較的良好と判断（manageability: No）。国際的拡大リスク（international_spread）および渡航・貿易制限リスク（travel_trade_restriction）は現在のところ認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Siêu vi khuẩn' tấn công não, tim khiến thiếu nữ 16 tuổi nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Superbugs' attack the brain and heart, leaving a 16-year-old girl in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: 16-year-old girl from Son La Province, Vietnam, presented with severe sepsis and high fever (39–40°C), tachycardia, hypotension, and petechiae on palms and soles, indicating infectious endocarditis. Blood culture confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Imaging revealed bilateral scattered cerebral infarctions with concomitant cerebellar hemorrhage causing ataxia and right-sided weakness (3/5). Echocardiography showed mitral valve vegetations with severe mitral regurgitation. The patient had multi-organ involvement, including pneumonia, and was diagnosed with MRSA bacteremia, acute infectious endocarditis, and brain injury. After three days of targeted MRSA antibiotics, CRP fell from >200 mg/L to 10 mg/L; fever resolved; mobility recovered; right motor deficit resolved; cerebellar function improving; repeat MRI brain showed no remaining lesions and echocardiography vegetations reduced. Discharge expected within the week. Notably, no skin lesions; infection possibly entered via minor oral/throat mucosal lesions. Clinicians warn that persistent high fever with no response to standard therapy warrants consideration of severe disseminated infection.

article.articleHeadline: आरोग्यमंत्र्यांच्या माहितीचा बुरखा टराटरा फाटला, घाटीमध्ये रेबीजच्या लसीचा तुटवडा; रुग्णांना मोठा भुर्दंड
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister's information cloak torn apart; rabies vaccine shortage in the valley; patients endure a heavy ordeal.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine shortage hits government hospitals in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, despite state claims of sufficient stock. Health Minister Prakash Abitkar told the Legislative Council that rabies prophylaxis supplies are ample, but residents report shortages in the city, forcing them to buy vaccines from outside and have them administered in public hospitals. The gap between official assurances and on-ground access raises concerns about vaccine provisioning, supply chains, and affordability. Patients endure delays in post-exposure prophylaxis and variable care quality as they navigate external purchases. The report underscores the urgent need for transparent stock data, reliable distribution, and policies to ensure equitable access to rabies vaccination within public facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣の情報隠蔽が明かされる。谷間での狂犬病ワクチン不足。患者は大きな困難を強いられている。

triage.notes: 狂犬病ワクチン不足は医療システムの脆弱性を示唆し、住民が継続的に曝露されるリスクがある。ただし記事には実際の死亡例や患者数が明記されていない。政府当局（保健大臣）と現場の報告に乖離があり、供給・分配体制の信頼性が問題となっている。感染症危機というより医療供給危機の側面が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng chỉ sốt viêm họng, nữ sinh bất ngờ nguy kịch vì "siêu vi khuẩn" tấn công
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A female student who thought it was just fever and sore throat suddenly falls into critical condition as a superbug attacks.
article.articleSummary: On 16 March 2026, a 16-year-old girl from Son La, Vietnam, was admitted in critical condition to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases with MRSA bacteremia causing acute infectious endocarditis, pneumonia, and multifocal cerebral infarctions with intracerebral hemorrhage. She had a history of mitral valve regurgitation diagnosed in June 2025. She presented with high fever (up to 40°C), rigors, sore throat, and later developed Janeway lesions and nonpainful petechiae on the hands and feet. Blood culture confirmed MRSA. Imaging showed severe mitral regurgitation (two eccentric jets), pneumonia, brain infarcts with hemorrhage, and right arm weakness (3/5). Following urgent multidisciplinary discussion, a MRSA-directed antibiotic regimen was started. After 3 days, fever resolved, infection markers fell, consciousness returned, right arm strength recovered, and echocardiography showed reduced vegetations; MRI brain showed no prior lesions. Clinicians note MRSA can enter via mucosal surfaces and urge early evaluation for persistent fever and endocarditis signs.

article.articleHeadline: Toxocarose chez un homme de 62 ans atteint d'éosinophilie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toxocariasis in a 62-year-old man with eosinophilia.
article.articleSummary: North America under-recognizes toxocariasis as a cause of acute eosinophilia. Diagnosis relies on exposure history, clinical symptoms, eosinophilia, elevated IgE, and toxocara serology. A 62-year-old man with hypertension and chronic kidney disease presented with abdominal pain, then recurrent visits with facial edema, myalgias, and a nonproductive cough; later developed dyspnea. He developed acute kidney injury and marked eosinophilia (6.7 × 10^9/L) with leukocytosis; RSV was detected. Despite IV fluids, albumin, and corticosteroids (for suspected IgA nephropathy associated with RSV), eosinophilia persisted and raised concern for eosinophilic myocarditis due to rising troponin and BNP. He was transferred to a tertiary care center 12 days after the first emergency visit. Born in the Philippines, with prior residence in Saudi Arabia and Iran before immigrating to Canada; no recent animal exposure; works in waste management with PPE; IgE elevated; mastocytosis/lymphoma excluded; toxocara serology results not reported here.

triage.headline_ja: 好酸球増多症を伴う62歳男性におけるトキソカラ症

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thought it was a mild sore throat, a 16-year-old female student was attacked by a 'superbug' that invaded her brain, and her heart nearly stopped.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-16, a 16-year-old girl from Son La Province, Vietnam, developed MRSA septicemia with multi-organ involvement after high fever and sore throat were misdiagnosed as acute tonsillitis. She later exhibited persistent fever, fatigue, delirium, and Janeway lesions on the hands and feet, prompting transfer to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi. Blood cultures confirmed methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Echocardiography revealed infectious endocarditis with vegetations on the mitral valve and severe mitral regurgitation; CT/MRI showed scattered brain infarcts with cerebellar hemorrhages, causing ataxia and right arm paralysis. Diagnoses: MRSA septicemia, acute infectious endocarditis, cerebral infarcts with intracerebral hemorrhage, and secondary pneumonia. After 3 days of intensive MRSA-directed therapy and multidisciplinary care, her condition improved markedly. Likely entry via minor oral/mucosal injury rather than skin lesions; persistent fever with new signs warrants early invasive evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い咽頭炎と思っていたら、16歳の女子学生が「スーパーバグ」に脳と心を侵襲され、心停止に近づいた
triage.triage_reason: MRSA敗血症による重症感染症（心内膜炎・脳梗塞）の個別症例報告であり、重症度は高いが、単一症例であること、国際的な集団発生の兆候がなく、現時点では情報が不足しているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: MRSAは既知病原体であり、本症例は適切な治療により改善している個別重症症例。地域内でのアウトブレイク兆候や複数症例の報告がないため、現時点ではピックアップの閾値に達しない。しかし、予防可能な感染症の重症化例として継続的な監視が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng viêm họng nhẹ, nữ sinh 16 tuổi nguy kịch do siêu vi khuẩn kháng thuốc tấn công
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mistaken for a mild sore throat, 16-year-old female student in critical condition from antibiotic-resistant superbug attack.
article.articleSummary: A 16-year-old girl, Đ.T.N., from Sơn La, Vietnam, presented with sore throat and high fever but deteriorated into a critical MRSA infection. Laboratory confirmation identified methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). The infection caused pneumonia, infective endocarditis with severe mitral regurgitation, and neurological involvement including multiple cerebral infarcts and cerebellar hemorrhages, with Janeway lesions observed on the extremities. Despite no skin wounds, the bacterium likely entered via mucosal surfaces. After urgent, targeted antibiotic therapy, inflammatory marker CRP dropped from above 200 mg/L to 10 mg/L within 3 days; fever resolved; she became alert, regained motor function in the right arm, and MRI demonstrated resolution of brain lesions and reduced valvular vegetation. Clinicians highlight early recognition of persistent high fever, small-vessel hemorrhagic signs, and echocardiographic assessment to prevent severe cardiac and neurologic sequelae from MRSA.

triage.triage_reason: MRSA感染による重症症例（敗血性心内膜炎、脳梗塞等）の個別事例だが、地域的な流行の証拠に乏しく、集団発生や国際的拡大のリスクに関する情報が不明。個別症例の医学的教訓として重要だが、シグナルレベルのアウトブレイク指標がない。
triage.notes: 本事例はIHR基準2つ該当するが、あくまで個別重症症例の医学的報告であり、集団発生、流行の証拠がない。MRSA自体は既知の病原体で、当地での存在も予想範囲内。WPRO基準で『流行しやすさ』が不明（複数症例の報告なし）であり、地域的なアウトブレイク指標が不足しているため、WATCHレベル。続報で同地域の追加症例報告がないか要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Kolhapur Adamapur Yatra : बाळूमामांच्या यात्रेत विषबाधा; रथोत्सवावेळी वाटप केलेल्या लस्सीमुळे शंभरांवर भाविकांना विषबाधा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kolhapur Adamapur Yatra: Poisoning during Balumama's pilgrimage; over a hundred devotees poisoned due to the lassi distributed during the Rathotsav.
article.articleSummary: Over 100 devotees experienced vomiting and diarrhea after consuming free lassi distributed during the Rathotsav at Adamapur Yatra in Bhudargad taluka, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra (as of March 16, 2026). The incident occurred during Balumama's pilgrimage, with attendees from Karnataka state and Maharashtra's Solapur, Sangli, Miraj, Baramati, Jalna, and Kolhapur districts affected. The report attributes the illness to the open-lassi served at the event; laboratory confirmation and investigations are not described. This marks a mass beverage-related food poisoning linked to a religious gathering, highlighting cross-district participation in the Adamapur yatra. No further clinical details, patient triage, or public health advisories are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コルハプル アダマプル・ヤトラ: バルママの巡礼中の食中毒; ラトホツァフ期間に配布されたラッシー(フルーツミルク飲料)により100人以上の信者が中毒症状を呈する
triage.triage_reason: 100人以上の集団食中毒事件であり、複数州にまたがる参加者が影響を受けている。宗教イベント関連の大規模な急性消化器疾患であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本事件は100人以上が関与する明確な集団食中毒イベントであり、複数の州（マハラシュトラ州、カルナタカ州）に跨る参加者が発症している。疾患は「Unknown Illness」と分類されているが、症状の記載（嘔吐・下痢）から急性消化器疾患と推定される。開放式で提供されたラッシーが原因と記事では示唆されており、衛生管理の問題が懸念される。検査確認は記載されていない。宗教イベント関連の大規模な公衆衛生インシデントとして、早期の詳細情報収集とRRAが必要。
